Before taking this medicine, patients with allergic symptoms to this medicine (rash, redness (congestion and reddening), itching, etc.), those who have experienced allergic symptoms to cosmetics or eggs (fever, rash, joint pain, asthma, itching, etc.), and people with an allergic constitution should consult a doctor or pharmacist. Follow the prescribed dosage and administration carefully. If there is no improvement in symptoms after taking it for about 1 month, stop taking it immediately and consult a doctor or pharmacist.
entries.15세 이상 및 성인은 1회 1~2정 1일 2회 아침, 저녁 공복시(식전: Adults and those aged 15 years and older take 1 to 2 tablets per dose, 2 times a day, in the morning and evening on an empty stomach (before meals or between meals). However, take the smallest amount for the first dose and then increase or decrease it little by little while observing the shape and condition of the stool. Do not chew the tablets when taking them. Do not use continuously for more than 1 week.
entries.15세 이상 성인은 1일 3회, 1회 1포(90 mL), 만 11세 이상: Adults aged 15 years and over take 1 sachet (90 mL) per dose 3 times a day; children aged 11 years to under 15 years take 2/3 sachet (about 60 mL) per dose 3 times a day; children aged 7 years to under 11 years take 1/2 sachet (about 45 mL) per dose 3 times a day; children aged 3 years to under 7 years take 1/3 sachet (about 30 mL) per dose 3 times a day; children aged 2 years to under 3 years take 1/4 sachet (about 22.5 mL) per dose 3 times a day, in each case 30 minutes after a meal. If necessary it may be taken at bedtime, and as a rule the interval between doses is 4 hours.

In acute poisoning, administer medicinal charcoal within 30 minutes after ingestion of the poisonous substance. When the amount of poisonous substance ingested is known, the recommended dose of medicinal charcoal is usually 5-10 times the amount of the ingested poisonous substance. Increase or decrease the amount appropriately according to age and symptoms as directed by a doctor.

entries.1회 15 mL씩, 1일 2회 약 1분동안 입안을 헹구어 내거나 가글한: Use 15 mL per dose, twice a day: rinse the mouth or gargle for about 1 minute and then spit it out; use it after brushing the teeth. Immediately after use, avoid rinsing with water or another mouthwash, brushing the teeth, or having food. In the case of stomatitis caused by dentures, soak and clean the dentures for 15 minutes twice a day. The amount may be increased or decreased appropriately according to age and symptoms.

entries.1회 1정(0.025 mg), 1일 1~2회 백색면을 환부(질환 부위)점: Attach 1 tablet (0.025 mg) as 1 dose, 1 to 2 times a day, with the white side placed on the mucous membrane of the affected area (diseased site). The amount may be increased or decreased appropriately according to age and symptoms. Use this medicine in the following order. Put a little saliva on your fingertip, touch the colored side of the tablet with your fingertip so that the tablet sticks to it, then place the white side against the mucous membrane of the affected area (diseased site), press lightly with your fingertip for 2 to 3 seconds, and remove your finger.
entries.1회 1정을 성인(15세이상)은 1일 3회, 11세~14세는 1일 2회를: Adults (aged 15 years and over) take 1 tablet per dose 3 times a day, and children aged 11 to 14 years take 1 tablet per dose twice a day, before a meal (between meals or after a meal). The interval between doses is 4 hours or more. However, take the highest amount for the first dose, then increase or decrease the amount little by little while watching the shape and condition of the stool.

entries.1회 약 1 cm (0.2~0.5 g)의 양을 청결한 손가락이나 칫솔에: Put about 1 cm (0.2 to 0.5 g) per dose on a clean finger or a toothbrush, apply it to the gums or the affected area several times in 1 day, and then massage.
entries.2 mL(셀레늄으로서 1일 100 µg)을 복용하며, 1일 4 mL(셀레: Take 2 mL (100 µg of selenium per 1 day); the dose may be increased up to 4 mL per 1 day (200 µg as selenium). Hold the oral solution in the mouth for about 30 seconds to 1 minute and then swallow it slowly. Use this medicine for oral administration only; do not use it for injection.
entries.24개월 미만 소아, 임부 또는 임신하고 있을 가능성이 있는 여성 및 수: Children under 24 months of age, pregnant women or women who may be pregnant, and breastfeeding women must not take this medicine. Before taking this medicine, patients with hypersensitivity to this medicine, patients with severe chronic constipation, and those who have experienced intestinal obstruction (blocked bowel) should consult a doctor or pharmacist. Follow the prescribed dosage and administration carefully. When giving this medicine to children, administer it under the guidance and supervision of a guardian. If dehydration occurs, provide appropriate fluid replacement.
entries.30개월 이하의 유아, 눈 또는 눈주위, 점막 등, 습진, 상처부위, 민: Do not use this medicine in infants aged 30 months or younger, or on the eyes or the area around the eyes, mucous membranes, eczema, wounds, or sensitive skin. Before using this medicine, consult a doctor or pharmacist if you have experienced allergic symptoms caused by medicines or cosmetics (rash, redness (congested and reddened skin), itching, dermatitis caused by lacquer, etc.), if you have an allergic constitution, if you have severe moist skin (dampness), skin breakdown, or inflammation, if the user is a child, if you have a circulatory disorder or diabetes, if you are pregnant or may be pregnant, or if you are breastfeeding. Do not use large amounts on peeled skin surfaces or on areas with blisters. If there is no improvement in symptoms after about 5 to 6 days of use, stop using it immediately and consult a doctor or pharmacist. Follow the prescribed dosage and administration exactly. When giving it to a child, administer it under the guidance and supervision of a guardian. For external use only. Be careful not to let it get into the eyes; if it does get into the eyes, rinse immediately with clean water. Shake well before use.
entries.30개월 이하의 유아, 눈 주위, 습진, 옻 등에 의한 피부염, 상처부위: Do not use it on infants aged 30 months or under, around the eyes, on eczema, on dermatitis caused by lacquer, on wounded areas, or on mucous membranes. Before using this medicine, consult a doctor or pharmacist if you have experienced allergic symptoms caused by a medicine or cosmetic (for example rash, redness, itching, dermatitis caused by lacquer), if you have an allergic constitution, if you have severe skin maceration or moisture retention, or if the user is a child, a pregnant woman or a woman who may be pregnant, or a breast-feeding woman. When using it for a child, use it under the guidance and supervision of a guardian. Clean the affected area, wipe off sweat well, and then attach it. Do not warm the attached area with a heater or an electric blanket. Bathing while it is attached causes strong irritation, so remove it 30 minutes to 1 hour before bathing. Also, do not attach it immediately after bathing. If the symptoms do not improve after 5 to 6 days of use, stop using it immediately and consult a doctor or pharmacist. Use this medicine externally only. Follow the prescribed directions and amounts. Because symptoms of poisoning may appear if a large amount is absorbed through the skin, avoid long-term use over a wide surface.
entries.30개월 이하의 유아, 눈 주위, 점막 등, 습진, 옻 등에 의한 피부염: Do not use this medicine on infants aged 30 months or younger, around the eyes, on mucous membranes, on eczema, on dermatitis caused by lacquer or the like, or on wounds. Before using this medicine, patients with hypersensitivity to this medicine or to cosmetics, those with an allergic constitution, patients with severe wetness (dampness) or erosion (rawness), patients under a doctor's treatment, children, pregnant women or women who may be pregnant, and nursing mothers should consult a doctor or pharmacist. Follow the prescribed dosage and administration carefully. When giving it to children, administer it under the guidance and supervision of a guardian. If symptoms do not improve after 5 to 6 applications, consult a doctor or pharmacist. Use this medicine externally only. Be careful not to let it get into the eyes. Shake well before use and spray from a distance of 20 cm from the affected area (diseased area); do not spray continuously on the same area for 3 seconds or longer. Do not use it indoors where a fire is in use, and always ventilate the room after using it in a closed space.
entries.30개월 이하의 유아는 이 약을 사용하지 마십시오.이 약은 눈 또는 눈주: Do not use this medicine in infants aged 30 months or younger. Do not use this medicine on the eyes or around the eyes, on mucous membranes, on eczema, on wounded areas, or on sensitive skin. In particular, do not use large amounts on peeled skin surfaces or on areas with blisters. Before using this medicine, consult a doctor or pharmacist if you have experienced allergic reactions to medicines or cosmetics (rash, redness (congested and reddened), itching, dermatitis caused by lacquer, etc.), if you have an allergic constitution, if you have severe moist skin (dampness), erosion or inflammation, or if the user is a child. Follow the prescribed dosage and administration carefully. When using it in children, use it under the guidance and supervision of a guardian. Use this medicine for external use only; do not use it internally or inhale it. Be careful not to let it get into the eyes. If it does get into the eyes, rinse with water, and if the symptoms are severe, receive treatment from an ophthalmologist.
entries.30개월 이하의 유아는 이 약을 사용하지 마십시오.이 약을 사용하기 전에: Infants aged 30 months or under must not use this medicine. Before using this medicine, those who have experienced allergic symptoms to medicines or cosmetics (rash, redness, itching, dermatitis caused by lacquer, etc.), people with an allergic constitution, patients with severe moist skin, skin maceration or severe inflammation, and children should consult a doctor or pharmacist. Do not use it on or around the eyes, on mucous membranes, on eczema, on wounds, on sensitive skin, and especially on peeled skin surfaces or areas with blisters. Follow the prescribed dosage and administration carefully. When giving this medicine to children, administer it under the guidance and supervision of a guardian. Use this medicine for external use only. Be careful not to let it get into the eyes; if it does, rinse immediately with clean water. Shake well before use. If there is no improvement in symptoms after 5 to 6 days of use, stop using it immediately and consult a doctor or pharmacist.
entries.5세 이하의 소아, 출혈성 혈액 질환(혈우병, 혈소판 감소증, 자반증),: Do not use this medicine in children aged 5 years or younger, in patients with hemorrhagic blood disorders (hemophilia, thrombocytopenia, purpura), in patients in whom even minor bleeding could have serious consequences, or in patients with symptoms of atopic dermatitis. Do not use it around the eyes, on mucous membrane areas such as the lips, on wounds or areas that are red and swollen, on skin breakdown, or on severely cracked areas. Before using this medicine, patients with hypersensitivity to medicines or cosmetics and patients with severe moist skin or skin breakdown should consult a doctor or pharmacist. Follow the prescribed dosage and administration exactly. If symptoms do not improve after 2 weeks of use, stop using it and consult a doctor or pharmacist. Be careful not to let it get into the eyes; if it does get into the eyes, rinse with water or lukewarm water. For external use only. When giving it to a child, administer it under the guidance and supervision of a guardian. Do not touch the eyes or mucous membranes with hands that have come into contact with this product.
entries.6개월~만 1세는 1일 1포(4 g), 만 1~4세는 1일 1~2포(4~: Children from 6 months to 1 year of age take 1 packet (4 g) a day, children 1 to 4 years of age take 1 to 2 packets (4 to 8 g) a day, and children 4 to 8 years of age take 2 to 4 packets (8 to 16 g) a day. Dissolve each packet in 50 mL of water before taking it. If 1 packet a day is taken, take it in the morning; if more than 1 packet a day is taken, divide the dose between morning and evening. The effect of this medicine appears within 1 to 2 days (24 to 48 hours) after it is taken.
entries.6세∼12세 소아는 1회 10 mL씩, 4~6시간마다 복용하고 2세∼6세: Children aged 6 to 12 years take 1 dose of 10 mL every 4 to 6 hours, and children aged 2 to 6 years take 5 mL every 4 to 6 hours. Do not take 4 or more doses within 24 hours.

entries.바르비탈계 약물, 삼환계 항우울제 및 알코올을 복용한 사람은 이 약을 복: People who have taken barbiturates, tricyclic antidepressants, or alcohol should not take this medicine. Do not take it together with other anti-inflammatory analgesics. Before taking this medicine, patients on long-term warfarin and patients taking lithium or thiazide diuretics should consult a doctor or pharmacist.
entries.발·충혈되어 붉어짐, 가려움, 심한 복통(배 아픔), 복부 불쾌감, 설사: If rash, reddening from congestion, itching, severe abdominal pain (stomach ache), abdominal discomfort, diarrhea, vomiting, or cramps occur, stop taking this medicine immediately and consult a doctor or pharmacist.
entries.발진 · 충혈되어 붉어짐, 가려움, 심한 복통(배 아픔), 설사, 구토,: If rash, congestion and reddening, itching, severe abdominal pain (stomach ache), diarrhea, vomiting, abdominal discomfort, or convulsions occur, or if there is no improvement in constipation after taking it for about 1 week, stop taking it immediately and consult a doctor or pharmacist.
entries.발진 및 발적(충혈되어 붉어짐), 가려움, 부기, 자극감, 열감, 인비늘: If rash and redness, itching, swelling, irritation, a feeling of heat, scaling, desquamation (peeling of the skin like dandruff or flakes), skin maceration, dry skin and a feeling of skin tightness, or cracking of the skin occur, stop using this medicine immediately and consult a doctor or pharmacist.
entries.발진 및 발적, 가려움 등이 나타나는 경우 이 약의 사용을 즉각 중지하고: If rash and redness or itching occurs, stop using this medicine immediately and consult a doctor or pharmacist.
entries.발진 및 발적, 가려움, 구역 및 구토, 식욕부진, 변비, 부종, 배뇨곤: If rash and redness, itching, nausea and vomiting, loss of appetite, constipation, edema, difficulty urinating, (persistent or severe) thirst, or dizziness occurs, stop taking this medicine immediately and consult a doctor or pharmacist. Rarely, if shock (anaphylaxis), in which urticaria, swelling, and chest tightness appear right after taking the medicine together with a pale complexion, cold hands and feet, cold sweat, and difficulty breathing, or mucocutaneous ocular syndrome (Stevens-Johnson syndrome), toxic epidermal necrolysis (Lyell's syndrome), asthma, general languor, liver dysfunction such as jaundice, or interstitial pneumonia occurs, stop taking this medicine immediately and consult a doctor or pharmacist.

entries.발진 및 충혈되어 붉어지는 발적, 가려움, 부종 등이 나타나는 경우 이: If rash, redness, itching, or swelling occur, stop using this medicine immediately and consult a doctor or pharmacist.

entries.성인 및 12세 이상의 소아는 1일 10 mg씩, 2~12세 미만의 소아: Adults and children aged 12 years and older take 10 mg a day; children aged 2 to under 12 years take 10 mg a day if they weigh 30 kg or more and 5 mg a day if they weigh less than 30 kg, taken 1 time a day. Patients who are sensitive to adverse reactions take it in divided doses in the morning and evening. The dose may be increased or decreased appropriately according to age and symptoms. The dosing interval must be adjusted according to the patient's kidney function; for details, refer to the approved labeling.
entries.성인 및 12세 이상의 소아는 1회 10 mL를 1일 3회 매 식후에 복: Adults and children aged 12 years and older take 10 mL per dose, 3 times a day, after each meal.
Adults and children aged 12 years and older take 10 mg as 1 dose, 1 time a day. Children aged 2 years or older and under 12 years take 10 mg as 1 dose, 1 time a day if they weigh 30 kg or more, and 5 mg as 1 dose, 1 time a day if they weigh less than 30 kg. Patients who are sensitive to adverse reactions should divide the dose between morning and evening. The amount may be increased or decreased appropriately according to age and symptoms. For the dosage in patients with renal impairment, refer to the approved product information. Pediatric patients with renal impairment require dose adjustment based on the patient's renal clearance and body weight.
entries.성인 및 12세 이상의 소아는 1회 10~20 mL을 1일 4회(식후 및: Adults and children aged 12 years and older take 10 to 20 mL at a time, 4 times a day (after meals and before bedtime).
entries.성인 및 12세 이상의 소아는 1회 1∼1.5 g을 1일 3회 식후 30: Adults and children aged 12 years and older take 1 to 1.5 g at a time, 3 times a day, 30 minutes to 1 hour after meals. If necessary, 1 more dose may be taken before bedtime. Shake the suspension well before taking it.
entries.성인 및 12세 이상의 어린이는 1회 1~2캡슐씩 1일 2회 복용하십시오: Adults and children aged 12 years and older take 1 to 2 capsules per dose, 2 times a day. Those aged 3 to 12 years take 1 capsule per dose, 3 times a day. Those under 3 years of age take 1 capsule per dose, 2 times a day.
entries.성인 및 15세 이상 청소년은 1회 1포씩, 11세 이상~15세 미만은: Adults and adolescents aged 15 years and older take 1 sachet as 1 dose, those aged 11 years or older and under 15 years take 2/3 of a sachet as 1 dose, those aged 7 years or older and under 11 years take 1/2 of a sachet as 1 dose, and those aged 3 years or older and under 7 years take 1/3 of a sachet as 1 dose, 3 to 6 times a day without water. The interval between doses should be 2 hours or more.
entries.성인 및 6세 이상의 소아는 1일 1회 1정(10 mg)을 취침 전에 복: Adults and children aged 6 years and older take 1 tablet (10 mg) once a day before bedtime; patients who are sensitive to adverse reactions take 1/2 tablet (5 mg) each as divided doses in the morning and evening. Adjust the dose appropriately according to age and symptoms. In patients with renal impairment the dosing interval must be adjusted according to the patient's renal function, and in pediatric patients with renal impairment the dose must be adjusted individually taking into account the patient's renal clearance and body weight, so refer to the approved labeling for details.
entries.성인 및 8세 이상의 소아는 포장단위 1포(20 ml) 기준으로 1일 2: Adults and children aged 8 years and over take 20 to 40 mL (1 to 2 sachets) a day, based on a package unit of 1 sachet (20 mL). Depending on the symptoms, children in particular may take 20 mL (1 sachet) every two days. Dissolve 20 mL (1 sachet) of this medicine in water to make 50 mL and take it. It is recommended to take it in the morning. Children from 6 months to 7 years of age, based on a package unit of 1 sachet (8 mL), take 8 mL (1 sachet) a day at 6 months to 1 year of age, 8 to 16 mL (1 to 2 sachets) a day at 1 to 4 years of age, and 16 to 32 mL (2 to 4 sachets) a day at 4 to 7 years of age. When 1 sachet (8 mL) a day is taken, take it in the morning, and when more than 1 sachet (8 mL) a day is taken, divide it between morning and evening. Dissolve 8 mL (1 sachet) of this medicine in water to make 50 mL and take it.

Adults and children aged 8 years and older take 20 to 40 ml (1 to 2 packets) a day, based on a package unit of 1 packet (20 ml). Depending on symptoms, children in particular may take 20 ml (1 packet) every other day. Dissolve 20 ml (1 packet) of this medicine in water to make 50 ml and then take it. It is recommended to take it in the morning. For children from 6 months to 7 years of age, based on a package unit of 1 packet (8 ml), children 6 months to 1 year of age take 8 ml (1 packet) a day, children 1 to 4 years of age take 8 to 16 ml (1 to 2 packets) a day, and children 4 to 7 years of age take 16 to 32 ml (2 to 4 packets) a day. If 1 packet (8 ml) a day is taken, take it in the morning; if more than 1 packet (8 ml) a day is taken, divide the dose between morning and evening. Dissolve 8 ml (1 packet) of this medicine in water to make 50 ml and then take it.
entries.성인 및 만 12세 이상 소아는 1일 3-4회(사용간격은 최소 2시간 이: Adults and children aged 12 years and older take 1 tablet per dose, 3-4 times a day (with an interval of at least 2 hours between doses), letting it dissolve slowly in the mouth without chewing or swallowing it.
entries.성인 및 만 7세 이상의 소아는 1회 2번씩, 비강 내에 분무합니다.3시: Adults and children aged 7 years and older spray 2 times into the nasal cavity as 1 dose. Leave an interval of 3 hours or more between doses, and do not exceed 6 doses in 1 day.
entries.성인 및 청소년(12세 이상, 35 kg 이상)은 1회 10 mg(레보도: Adults and adolescents (aged 12 years and older, weighing 35 kg or more) take 10 mg at a time (5 mg when levodopa is being administered), 3 times a day before meals. The maximum daily dose is 30 mg, and it should generally not be used for more than 1 week.
entries.성인(만 15세 이상)은 1회 2정씩, 어린이(만 8세 이상～만 15세: Adults (aged 15 years and older) take 2 tablets at a time and children (aged 8 years to under 15 years) take 1 tablet at a time, 3 times a day, 30 minutes after meals. Those aged 15 years and older take 2 packets, those aged 11 years to under 15 years take 1⅓ packets, those aged 7 years to under 11 years take 1 packet, those aged 3 years to under 7 years take 2/3 packet, and those aged 2 years to under 3 years take 1/2 packet, 3 times a day, 30 minutes after meals. As a rule, keep the interval between doses at 4 hours.
entries.성인에서 복통 및 복부팽만, 설사, 구역, 흔하지 않게 구토, 긴급한 배: In adults, if abdominal pain and abdominal distension, diarrhea or nausea appears, if vomiting, urgent defecation or fecal incontinence uncommonly appears, if electrolyte disturbance (hyponatremia, hypokalemia, etc.), dehydration or erythema appears at an unknown frequency, or if a hypersensitivity reaction (itching, rash, facial edema, angioedema, urticaria, anaphylactic shock, etc.) very rarely appears, stop taking it immediately and consult a doctor or pharmacist. In children, if abdominal pain, diarrhea or perianal pain caused by diarrhea appears, if vomiting, abdominal distension or nausea uncommonly appears, or if a hypersensitivity reaction (hypersensitivity, angioedema, urticaria, rash, itching, etc.) appears at an unknown frequency, stop taking it immediately and consult a doctor or pharmacist.

In adults, if abdominal pain and bloating, diarrhea, or nausea occurs, uncommonly vomiting or urgent bowel movements, with unknown frequency fecal incontinence, electrolyte disturbances (hyponatremia, hypokalemia, etc.), dehydration, or erythema, or very rarely hypersensitivity reactions (itching, rash, facial swelling, angioedema, hives, anaphylaxis, shock, etc.), stop taking it immediately and consult a doctor or pharmacist. In children, if abdominal pain, diarrhea and pain around the anus caused by diarrhea occurs, uncommonly vomiting, abdominal bloating, or nausea, or very rarely hypersensitivity reactions (hypersensitivity, angioedema, hives, rash, itching, etc.), stop taking it immediately and consult a doctor or pharmacist.
entries.성인은 1일 10~30 mL를 식간에 분할 복용합니다.이 약 10 mL를: Adults take 10 to 30 mL a day, divided into several doses between meals. Dilute 10 mL of this medicine in about half a cup of water before taking it.
entries.성인은 1일 2~3 g을 2~3회 분할 경구투여합니다.연령(나이), 증상: Adults take 2 to 3 g a day orally in 2 to 3 divided doses. Adjust the dose appropriately according to age and symptoms.
entries.성인은 1일 2~3병을 복용합니다.어린이 및 청소년은 1일 1∼2병을 물: Adults take 2 to 3 bottles a day. Children and adolescents take 1 to 2 bottles a day, diluted (thinned) in water. Infants and premature babies take 1 bottle a day, diluted (thinned) in water. In this medicine the powder in the upper container and the liquid in the lower container are separated, so mix and shake them just before taking it.
entries.성인은 1일 2포(2 g)~8포(8 g), 2세 이상의 소아는 1일 1포: Adults take 2 packets (2 g) to 8 packets (8 g) a day, and children aged 2 years and older take 1 packet (1 g) to 4 packets (4 g) a day. Take 1 dose between meals with a drink or with milk.
entries.성인은 1일 3회 1회 5 mL, 2~4세는 1일 2회 1회 2 mL,: Adults take 5 mL as 1 dose, 3 times a day; children aged 2 to 4 years take 2 mL as 1 dose, 2 times a day; children aged 4 to 7 years take 3 mL as 1 dose, 2 times a day; and children aged 7 to 15 years take 5 mL as 1 dose, 2 times a day. The amount may be increased or decreased appropriately according to age and symptoms. Shake before use.
entries.성인은 1회 1~2정(300~600 mg), 1일 3회 식간에 복용합니다: Adults take 1 to 2 tablets (300 to 600 mg) at a time, 3 times a day between meals. Adjust the dose appropriately according to age and symptoms.
Adults take 1 to 2 tablets per dose, twice a day, when pain or an attack occurs.
entries.성인은 1회 1방울씩, 1일 2~4회 또는 상태에 따라 적절히 점안합니다: Adults instill 1 drop at a time, 2 to 4 times a day, or as appropriate depending on the condition. For infants and children, follow the doctor's prescription.
Adults take 1 bottle per dose, 1 time a day.
entries.성인은 1회 1정, 1일 1회 복용합니다.이 약은 장용정이므로 충분한 물: Adults take 1 tablet as 1 dose, 1 time a day. Since this medicine is an enteric-coated tablet, it may be taken before meals with plenty of water.
Adults take 1 tablet per dose, once a day.
entries.성인은 1회 1캡슐(30 mg)씩 1일 3회 복용합니다.연령, 증상에 따: Adults take 1 capsule (30 mg) at a time, 3 times a day. The dose may be adjusted appropriately according to age and symptoms.
entries.성인은 1회 1캡슐(300 mg)씩, 1일 2~4회 복용합니다.단, 1일: Adults take 1 capsule (300 mg) at a time, 2 to 4 times a day. However, do not exceed 4 capsules (1,200 mg) a day.
entries.성인은 1회 1캡슐, 1일 1회 복용합니다.이 약은 장용캡슐이므로 충분한: Adults take 1 capsule per dose, 1 time a day. Since this medicine is an enteric-coated capsule, it may be taken before meals with plenty of water.
Adults take 1 capsule per dose 3 times a day after meals.
entries.성인은 1회 1캡슐을 식후 씹거나 삼켜서 복용합니다: Adults take 1 capsule as 1 dose after meals, either chewing it or swallowing it.
entries.성인은 1회 1포(병)씩, 1일 3회 식후 30분에 4시간 간격을 두고: Adults take 1 sachet (bottle) at a time, 3 times a day, 30 minutes after meals, with an interval of 4 hours between doses.
entries.성인은 1회 1포씩, 1일 1회 식사와 함께 이 약 그대로 복용하거나 물: Adults take 1 packet at a time, 1 time a day, taking this medicine as it is with a meal or diluted in water.
entries.성인은 1회 20 mL, 11세 이상~15세 미만은 1회 13 mL, 8: Adults take 20 mL per dose, those aged 11 years to under 15 years take 13 mL per dose, those aged 8 years to under 11 years take 10 mL per dose, those aged 5 years to under 8 years take 7 mL per dose, those aged 3 years to under 5 years take 5 mL per dose, and those aged 2 years to under 3 years take 4 mL per dose, 3 to 4 times a day, after meals and at bedtime.
Adults take 20 ml as 1 dose, 3 times a day, 30 minutes after meals.
entries.성인은 1회 2번씩, 만 7세 이상~만 15세 미만 소아는 1회 1번씩: Adults spray 2 sprays at a time and children aged 7 years to under 15 years spray 1 spray at a time into the nasal cavity. Allow an interval of at least 3 hours between doses and do not exceed 6 times a day.
Adults take 1 dose of 2 capsules, 3 times a day.
entries.성인은 1회 3 g을 1일 3회 복용합니다.급성설사시의 초기 3일은 1일: Adults take 3 g per dose, 3 times a day. For the first 3 days of acute diarrhea, the daily dose may be doubled to 2 times the usual amount. For esophagitis take it after meals, and for other indications take it between meals. Children aged 24 months and older take 6 to 9 g a day in 3 divided doses for 3 days, and then 6 g a day in 3 divided doses for the next 4 days.

Adults take 3 g as 1 dose, 3 times a day. During the first 3 days of acute diarrhea, the daily dose may be doubled (2 times). For esophagitis, take it after meals; for other indications, take it between meals. Children aged 24 months and older take 6 to 9 g a day divided into 3 doses for 3 days, and then 6 g a day divided into 3 doses for the following 4 days. Shake the suspension well before taking it.
Adults take 4 tablets at a time, 3 times a day, before meals or between meals.
entries.성인은 1회 8 mL, 11세 이상~15세 미만은 1회 5 mL, 8세: Adults take 8 mL as 1 dose, those aged 11 years to under 15 years take 5 mL at a time, those aged 8 years to under 11 years take 4 mL at a time, those aged 3 years to under 8 years take 2 mL at a time, and those aged 2 years to under 3 years take 1.5 mL at a time, 3 times a day. It may be taken up to 6 times a day, and the interval between doses should be 4 hours or more.
entries.성인은 보통 1회 1정씩, 1일 1회로 연속 6일간 취침 시에 질내 깊숙: Adults usually insert 1 tablet per dose deep into the vagina at bedtime, 1 time a day for 6 consecutive days. When used as short-term therapy, adults insert 2 tablets per dose deep into the vagina at bedtime, 1 time a day for 3 consecutive days.
entries.성인은 보통의 경우 처음 2～3일간 1일 15~30 mL를 아침식전에 경: Adults usually take 15 to 30 mL orally a day before breakfast for the first 2 to 3 days, and then continue with 10 to 15 mL a day. In severe cases, up to 45 mL may be given. Children (7 to 14 years) are given 15 mL a day for the first 2 to 3 days, and then continue with 10 mL a day. Young children (1 to 6 years) are given 5 to 10 mL a day. Infants (under 12 months) are given 5 mL a day.
entries.성인은 처음 복용 시 아침 또는 저녁 식사와 함께 1일 1회 30 mL(: For the first doses, adults take 30 mL (20 g) once a day with breakfast or dinner, and in most patients, several days after the initial administration, the maintenance dose is 15 mL (10 g) once a day. The average dose for children is 0.375 mL (0.25 g) per kg of body weight per day: children aged 1 to 6 years take 3.75 to 7.5 mL (2.5 to 5 g) a day, children aged 6 to 12 years take 7.5 to 15 mL (5 to 10 g) a day, and those aged 12 to 16 years take 15 to 30 mL (10 to 20 g) a day. This medicine may be mixed with hot or cold drinks, cereal, pudding, and the like. Because the response varies from patient to patient, for patients with constipation the dose needs to be adjusted to the amount required for one bowel movement a day.
entries.성인은 첫날에는 1회 2정씩, 1일 4회 복용합니다.이후에는 유지량으로: On the first day, adults take 2 tablets at a time, 4 times a day. After that, as a maintenance dose, they take 1 tablet at a time, 4 times a day.
entries.성인은 통증으로 인해 잠을 자기 어려운 경우 1회 1~2캡슐씩, 1일 1: When adults have difficulty sleeping because of pain, take 1 to 2 capsules per dose, 1 time a day before bedtime. Including this medicine, do not exceed 1,200 mg of ibuprofen and 75 mg of diphenhydramine within 24 hours. Keep the interval between doses at 4 hours or more after taking ibuprofen and/or diphenhydramine. If the cause of the symptoms has not been identified, do not take it continuously for more than 5 days.
entries.성인은 환부의 가장자리까지 충분히 적용할 수 있는 적당량으로 하여 1일: Adults use an appropriate amount, enough to cover the affected area fully to its edge, 5 times a day for 5 days. Limit the treatment period with this medicine to 5 days or less. Start the treatment as soon as possible, right when the first symptoms and signs appear.
Adults use an amount sufficient to cover the affected area up to its edges, 5 times a day for 5 days. Start treatment as soon as possible as soon as the first symptoms and signs appear.
entries.성인은 흔하게 복통, 복부팽만, 설사, 구역, 흔하지 않게 구토, 긴급한: If in adults abdominal pain, abdominal distension, diarrhea, or nausea occurs commonly, or vomiting, urgent bowel movements, or fecal incontinence occurs uncommonly, or erythema of unknown frequency, or in elderly patients electrolyte disturbances (hyponatremia, hypokalemia) and dehydration, or very rarely hypersensitivity reactions (itching, rash, facial edema, angioedema, urticaria, anaphylactic shock), or if in children abdominal pain or diarrhea occurs commonly, or vomiting, abdominal distension, or nausea occurs uncommonly, or hypersensitivity reactions of unknown frequency (hypersensitivity, angioedema, urticaria, rash, itching) occur, stop taking it immediately and consult a doctor or pharmacist.
entries.소독부위(보건위생종사자 및 수술 시 수술자의 손 소독, 수술부위 피부의: Apply it to the area to be disinfected (excluding hand disinfection of health and hygiene workers and of the surgeon during an operation, and disinfection of the skin at the surgical site).
Apply it to the area to be disinfected.
entries.소화성궤양, 심한 혈액이상, 간장애, 심기능부전, 신장장애, 고혈압 환자: Patients with peptic ulcer, severe blood disorders, liver disorder, cardiac insufficiency, kidney disorder or high blood pressure, patients with hypersensitivity to the ingredients of this medicine or to non-steroidal anti-inflammatory analgesics such as aspirin, those who have experienced asthma, rhinitis, nasal polyps, urticaria or allergic reactions caused by aspirin or other non-steroidal anti-inflammatory analgesics, patients being treated for pain occurring before or after coronary artery bypass surgery, and pregnant women (in late pregnancy) must not take this medicine. Before taking this medicine, patients with peptic ulcer or blood disorders or those who have experienced them, patients with a tendency to bleed, patients with liver disorder or a history of it, patients with kidney disorder or a history of it and patients with reduced renal blood flow, patients with impaired cardiac function, patients with high blood pressure, those who have experienced hypersensitivity, patients with bronchial asthma, patients with systemic lupus erythematosus (SLE) and patients with mixed connective tissue disease (MCTD), and elderly people should consult a doctor or pharmacist.

entries.수두, 무좀, 백선 등 또는 화농되어 있는 부위에는 사용하지 마십시오.이: Do not use it on chickenpox, athlete's foot, ringworm, or on areas that have become purulent. Before using this medicine, patients with hypersensitivity to medicines or cosmetics, patients with an allergic constitution, patients with severe moist skin or erosion (skin breakdown), and patients whose affected area is widespread should consult a doctor or pharmacist. Follow the prescribed dosage and administration exactly. When giving it to a child, administer it under the guidance and supervision of a guardian. This medicine is for external use only; do not use it internally. Be careful not to let it get into the eyes; if it does get into the eyes, rinse immediately with water. Do not use it for purposes other than treatment, such as as a makeup base or after shaving.
entries.수술자의 손 및 팔의 살균소독 시 이 약 5 mL를 취하여 손과 팔에 약: For disinfecting the surgeon's hands and arms, measure out 5 mL of this medicine, rub it well into the hands and arms for about 2 minutes and 30 seconds to work up plenty of lather, and then rinse thoroughly under running water. For disinfecting the hands, measure out 5 mL of this medicine, rub it into the hands for about 1 minute, and rinse thoroughly under running water. For disinfecting the surgical site, apply this medicine directly or use an appropriate amount, rub it well to work up plenty of lather, and then wipe it off with sterile gauze.

Nebulization therapy using a mist tent or an inhalation device (Croupette) is a method needed in special cases and is used on an individual basis according to the patient's personal needs and the convenience of the administration method. This method of administration requires a large volume of solution, and sometimes up to about 300 mL may be required for a single treatment. The recommended amount should be a volume that can maintain a very dense, fog-like state inside the tent or inhalation device throughout the treatment period. Intermittent or continuous long-term administration is desirable. For direct instillation, administer 1 to 2 mL every hour. For the routine treatment of patients who have had a tracheostomy, administer 1 to 2 mL through the tracheostomy every 1 to 4 hours. When administering directly to a specific part of the bronchial tree of the lung by inserting a small plastic catheter into the trachea under local anesthesia and a direct incision, administer 2 to 5 mL every 1 to 4 hours using a syringe connected to the catheter. For diagnostic bronchography, administer 1 to 2 mL 2 to 3 times before performing the bronchography, by nebulization or by instillation into the bronchi.
