Before taking this medicine, patients with or a history of blood disorders, patients with a bleeding tendency, patients with or a history of liver disorder or kidney disorder, patients with fluid retention (accumulation of body fluid) or heart failure, patients with high blood pressure, those who have experienced hypersensitivity, patients with systemic lupus erythematosus (SLE) or mixed connective tissue disease (MCTD), elderly people, children aged 6 years and older, patients with stomach cancer or alcoholism, pregnant women in early or mid pregnancy and women who may be pregnant, patients with ischemic heart disease, peripheral arterial disease, cerebrovascular disease, or risk factors for cardiovascular disease (e.g., high blood pressure, hyperlipidemia, diabetes, smoking), patients with hepatic porphyria, patients who have had major surgery that caused blood loss, patients with a blood coagulation disorder or who are receiving anticoagulants, and those who have experienced hypersensitivity or an allergic reaction to Yellow No. 5 should consult a doctor or pharmacist. Considering the importance of the drug treatment, either stop breastfeeding or stop taking the drug. Dizziness or fatigue may occur after taking this medicine, so be careful when driving or operating machinery. When it is taken for a long period for an acute illness, in principle this should be limited to within 5 days.
entries.이 약에 과민증 환자, 위장관궤양, 위장관 출혈 또는 경험자, 심한 혈액: Patients who are hypersensitive to this medicine, patients with gastrointestinal ulcer or gastrointestinal bleeding or a history of them, severe blood abnormalities, severe liver impairment, severe kidney impairment, severe cardiac insufficiency, severe high blood pressure, or bronchial asthma or a history of it, patients who have hypersensitivity such as asthma, hives, or allergic reactions to aspirin or other non-steroidal anti-inflammatory analgesics (including COX-2 inhibitors) or a history of it, patients with pain occurring before or after coronary artery bypass surgery, women in the last 3 months of pregnancy, patients taking high-dose methotrexate as cancer chemotherapy, and patients with genetic problems such as galactose intolerance, Lapp lactase deficiency, or glucose-galactose malabsorption must not take this medicine. Before taking this medicine, consult a doctor or pharmacist if you have blood abnormalities or a history of them, a bleeding tendency, liver cirrhosis, liver impairment or a history of it, kidney impairment or a history of it, cardiac insufficiency or heart disease, high blood pressure, systemic lupus erythematosus or mixed connective tissue disease, ulcerative colitis, or Crohn's disease; if the user is elderly or a child; if you are pregnant or breastfeeding; or if you are hypersensitive to Yellow No. 5.

This medicine must not be taken by patients with hypersensitivity to this medicine, by patients who have or have had gastrointestinal ulcer or gastrointestinal bleeding, by patients with severe blood abnormality, severe liver impairment, severe renal impairment, severe cardiac insufficiency or severe high blood pressure, by patients who have or have had bronchial asthma, by patients who have or have had hypersensitivity such as asthma, urticaria or an allergic reaction to aspirin or another non-steroidal anti-inflammatory analgesic (including COX-2 inhibitors), by patients with pain occurring before or after coronary artery bypass surgery, by pregnant women in the last 3 months of pregnancy, by patients taking high-dose methotrexate as anticancer therapy, or by patients with hereditary problems such as galactose intolerance, Lapp lactase deficiency or glucose-galactose malabsorption. Before taking this medicine, consult a doctor or pharmacist if the user has or has had blood abnormality, has a bleeding tendency, has or has had cirrhosis or liver impairment, has or has had renal impairment, has cardiac insufficiency or heart disease, high blood pressure, a history of hypersensitivity, systemic lupus erythematosus or mixed connective tissue disease, ulcerative colitis or Crohn's disease, is elderly or a child, is a pregnant woman or a breast-feeding woman, or is taking low-dose aspirin to prevent myocardial infarction or stroke. Without the direction of a doctor or pharmacist, do not take it for pain for 10 days or more (adults) or 5 days or more (children), and do not take it for fever for 3 days or more.

Patients with hypersensitivity to this medicine, patients with gastrointestinal ulcer or gastrointestinal bleeding or a history of it, patients with severe blood disorders, severe liver disorder, severe kidney disorder, severe cardiac insufficiency, severe high blood pressure or bronchial asthma or a history of it, patients with hypersensitivity such as asthma, urticaria or allergic reactions to aspirin or other non-steroidal anti-inflammatory analgesics (including COX-2 inhibitors) or a history of it, patients with pain occurring before or after coronary artery bypass graft surgery (CABG), pregnant women in the last 3 months of pregnancy, and patients receiving high-dose methotrexate as anticancer therapy must not take this medicine. Before taking this medicine, patients with blood disorders or a history of them, patients with a tendency to bleed, patients with liver cirrhosis, liver disorder or a history of it, patients with kidney disorder or a history of it, patients with cardiac insufficiency or heart disease, high blood pressure, systemic lupus erythematosus (SLE) and mixed connective tissue disease (MCTD), ulcerative colitis or Crohn's disease, elderly people and children, pregnant women, and breastfeeding women should consult a doctor or pharmacist. Follow the prescribed dosage and administration carefully.
entries.이 약에 과민증 환자, 위장관궤양, 위장관출혈, 심한 혈액이상, 심한 간: Patients with hypersensitivity to this medicine, gastrointestinal ulcer, gastrointestinal bleeding, severe blood abnormalities, severe hepatic impairment, severe renal impairment, severe cardiac insufficiency, severe high blood pressure, or bronchial asthma, patients who have experienced asthma, urticaria, or allergic reactions caused by aspirin or other anti-inflammatory analgesics, patients with pain occurring before or after coronary artery bypass surgery, pregnant women in the last 3 months of pregnancy, breastfeeding women, patients receiving high-dose methotrexate as cancer chemotherapy, and patients with hereditary problems such as galactose intolerance, Lapp lactase deficiency, or glucose-galactose malabsorption should not take this medicine. Do not take more than the recommended dose. Before taking this medicine, patients with blood abnormalities or a bleeding tendency, patients with liver cirrhosis, hepatic impairment, renal impairment, cardiac insufficiency, heart disease, high blood pressure, systemic lupus erythematosus, mixed connective tissue disease, ulcerative colitis, or Crohn's disease, elderly people, children under 2 years of age, pregnant women, and patients with chickenpox should consult a doctor or pharmacist. When taking it for a cold, take it for no more than 5 days as a rule, and without the direction of a doctor or pharmacist do not take it for pain for 10 days or more (adults) or 5 days or more (children), and do not take it for fever for 3 days or more.
entries.이 약에 과민증 환자, 이 약 또는 다른 해열진통제, 감기약 복용 시 천: Patients with hypersensitivity to this medicine, people who have had an asthma attack when taking this medicine or other antipyretic analgesics or cold medicines, infants under 3 months of age, people who are taking MAO inhibitors or are within 2 weeks of stopping them, and patients with genetic problems such as galactose intolerance, Lapp lactase deficiency, or glucose-galactose malabsorption must not take this medicine. Before taking this medicine, infants and children under 15 years of age who are infected with or suspected of having chickenpox or influenza, infants and young children under 2 years of age, those with an allergic constitution, those who have experienced drug allergy (fever, rash, redness, swelling, irritation, joint pain, asthma, itching, etc.), people with liver, kidney, heart, or thyroid disease, diabetes, high blood pressure, edema, gastroduodenal ulcer, glaucoma, or difficulty urinating, elderly people, people who are physically weak or have a high fever, people with persistent or recurring stomach problems such as heartburn, stomach discomfort, or stomach pain or with ulcer or bleeding problems, pregnant women or women who may be pregnant, nursing mothers, people who smoke or have asthma, chronic bronchitis, emphysema, a cough accompanied by excessive phlegm, a cough lasting or recurring for 1 week or longer, a chronic cough, or a cough accompanied by fever, rash, or persistent headache, and patients with hypersensitivity to Yellow No. 5 should consult a doctor or pharmacist. If there is no improvement in symptoms after taking it 5 to 6 times, stop taking it immediately and consult a doctor or pharmacist. Follow the prescribed dosage and administration carefully. Drowsiness may occur after taking it, so be careful when driving or operating machinery.
entries.이 약에 과민증 환자, 이 약의 구성성분 또는 다른 해열진통제, 감기약: Patients who are hypersensitive to this medicine, people who have experienced asthma when taking the ingredients of this medicine or other antipyretic analgesics or cold remedies, and infants (newborns) under 3 months of age must not take this medicine. Before taking this medicine, consult a doctor or pharmacist if the user is an infant or young child under 2 years of age; if the user is an infant (nursing infant, newborn) or a child under 15 years of age who has or is suspected of having chickenpox or influenza; if the user is a child under 2 years of age; if you have an allergic constitution or have experienced allergic reactions (fever, rash, joint pain, asthma, itching, etc.); if you have liver disease, kidney disease, heart disease, thyroid disease, diabetes, high blood pressure, gastroduodenal ulcer, glaucoma (eye pain, blurred vision, etc.), or difficulty urinating; if you are elderly, frail, or have a high fever; if you have persistent or recurring stomach problems such as heartburn, stomach discomfort, or stomach pain, or ulcer or bleeding problems; if you are pregnant, may be pregnant, or are breastfeeding; or if you smoke or have asthma, chronic bronchitis, emphysema, a cough accompanied by excessive phlegm, a cough that lasts or recurs for 1 week or more, a chronic cough, or a cough accompanied by fever and rash or a persistent headache. If the symptoms do not improve after taking 5 to 6 doses, stop taking it immediately and consult a doctor or pharmacist. Follow the prescribed dosage and administration carefully. When giving it to a child, administer it under the guidance and supervision of a guardian. Drowsiness may occur after taking it, so be careful when driving or operating machinery.
entries.이 약에 과민증 환자, 임부 또는 임신하고 있을 가능성이 있는 여성 및: Patients with hypersensitivity to this medicine, pregnant women or women who may be pregnant and breastfeeding women, and infants and young children must not use this medicine. Do not use it on the eyes or around the eyes, on mucous membranes (inside the mouth, inside the nose, the vagina, etc.), on the genitals, the external genitalia, eczema, moist areas, macerated skin, or diseased areas with severe cracking or wounds, on the nails, or on the scalp. Before using this medicine, those who have experienced allergic symptoms to medicines, people with an allergic constitution, people whose diseased area is festering or is on the face or is extensive, and people who are not sure whether their condition is eczema or athlete's foot, tinea cruris or tinea corporis should consult a doctor or pharmacist. Follow the prescribed dosage and administration carefully. Be careful not to let it get into the eyes, and if it does, rinse immediately with water or warm water. Do not touch your eyes or mucous membranes with hands that have this medicine on them. Use this medicine for external use only; do not use it internally. If there is no improvement in symptoms after using it for about 2 weeks, stop using it immediately and consult a doctor or pharmacist.

Patients with hypersensitivity to this medicine, pregnant women or women who may be pregnant and breastfeeding women, and infants and children should not use this medicine. Do not use it on the eyes or the area around the eyes, on mucous membranes (inside the mouth, inside the nose, the vagina), on the scrotum or external genitalia, on eczema, on diseased areas with severe moistness (dampness), skin breakdown, cracking, or injury (wounds), on the nails, or on the scalp. Before using this medicine, people with an allergic constitution, patients whose diseased area is on the face or is widespread or has become purulent (festering), and patients with hypersensitivity to propylene glycol or those who have experienced it should consult a doctor or pharmacist. Follow the prescribed dosage and administration exactly. Do not use it while the diseased area or the area around it is dirty. Do not touch your eyes or mucous membranes with hands that have this medicine on them. Be careful not to let it get into the eyes; if it does get into the eyes, rinse immediately with cold or lukewarm water. This medicine is for external use only.

Patients with hypersensitivity to this medicine, pregnant women or women who may be pregnant and nursing mothers, and young children and children must not use this medicine. Do not use it on or around the eyes, on mucous membranes (the mouth, the inside of the nose, the vagina), on the scrotum or the vulva, on eczema, on diseased areas with severe wetness (dampness), rawness, cracking, or injury (wounds), on the nails, or on the scalp. Before using this medicine, those with an allergic constitution, those whose diseased area is on the face or is extensive or suppurating (festering), and patients with hypersensitivity to propylene glycol or a history of it should consult a doctor or pharmacist. Follow the prescribed dosage and administration carefully. Do not use it while the diseased area or the area around it is dirty. Be careful not to let it get into the eyes, and if it does get into the eyes, rinse immediately with cold or lukewarm water. Use this medicine externally only.

Patients who are hypersensitive to this medicine, women who are pregnant, may be pregnant, or are breastfeeding, infants, and children must not use this medicine, and it must not be used on or around the eyes, on mucous membranes (inside the mouth, inside the nose, the vagina), on the scrotum or external genitalia, on eczema, on moist (damp) areas, on erosion, on diseased areas with severe cracking or wounds, on the nails, or on the scalp. Before using this medicine, consult a doctor or pharmacist if you have an allergic constitution or have experienced allergic symptoms, if the diseased area is on the face or is extensive or festering, or if you are hypersensitive to propylene glycol or have been in the past. Follow the prescribed dosage and administration carefully. Clean the diseased area and its surroundings before use. Be careful not to let it get into the eyes, and if it does get into the eyes, rinse them immediately with water or warm water. Do not touch your eyes or mucous membranes with hands that have this medicine on them. Use this medicine for external use only; do not use it internally.

Patients with hypersensitivity to this medicine and pregnant women or women who may be pregnant and breastfeeding women must not use this medicine, and it must not be used on mucous membranes such as the vagina, bladder or mouth, or in the eyes. Before using this medicine, patients with an allergic constitution should consult a doctor or pharmacist. Use it for external use only. Be careful not to let it get into the eyes, and if it does, rinse thoroughly with clean water immediately. Do not use it on extensive wounds or burns. Since soaps weaken the disinfecting action of this medicine, wash them off thoroughly before use. Do not use it for gynecological purposes (disinfection of the vagina or external genitalia, etc.) or urological purposes (disinfection of the external genitals or mucous membranes, etc.).
entries.이 약에 과민증 환자, 임부 또는 임신하고 있을 가능성이 있는 여성, M: Patients with hypersensitivity to this medicine, pregnant women or women who may be pregnant, people who are taking an MAO inhibitor (antidepressants, antipsychotics, mood regulators, antiparkinsonian drugs, etc.) or who stopped taking one within the past 2 weeks, children under 3 years of age, and patients with hereditary problems such as galactose intolerance, Lapp lactase deficiency, or glucose-galactose malabsorption should not take this medicine (applies to the mint flavor). Before taking this medicine, people with an allergic constitution, people who have experienced allergic symptoms from medicines (e.g., fever, rash, joint pain, itching, etc.), patients with diseases such as liver disease, kidney disease, thyroid disease, or diabetes, patients with a high fever, frail people, patients with heart disease and high blood pressure, elderly people, breastfeeding women, patients with edema (swelling), patients with smoking, asthma, chronic bronchitis, or emphysema, a cough accompanied by excessive phlegm, a cough that lasts 1 week or more or recurs, a chronic cough, or a cough accompanied by fever, rash, or persistent headache, and people who have experienced hypersensitivity or an allergic reaction to Yellow No. 5 (applies to the mint flavor and the mint coffee flavor) should consult a doctor or pharmacist. If there is no improvement in symptoms after 5 to 6 doses, stop taking it immediately and consult a doctor or pharmacist. Follow the prescribed dosage and administration exactly. When giving it to a child, administer it under the guidance and supervision of a guardian.
entries.이 약에 과민증 환자, 임부, 수유부, 2세 이하의 영아는 이 약을 복용: Patients with hypersensitivity to this medicine, pregnant women, nursing mothers, and infants aged 2 years or younger must not take this medicine.
entries.이 약에 과민증 환자, 임신 3기, 눈 또는 눈 주위에는 이 약을 사용하: Patients who are hypersensitive to this medicine and women in the 3rd trimester of pregnancy must not use this medicine, and it must not be used on or around the eyes. Before using this medicine, pregnant women (in the 1st and 2nd trimesters), patients who are allergic to medicines or cosmetics or have been in the past, and people with severe moist skin or erosion should consult a doctor or pharmacist. If there is no improvement in symptoms, stop using it immediately and consult a doctor or pharmacist. Use it only on the areas with acne or pimples, and do not use it on large surrounding areas, around the eyes, on deep wounds, or on severe burns. Be careful not to let it get into the eyes. If it does get into the eyes, rinse them immediately with water or lukewarm water. If the irritation persists, consult a doctor or pharmacist. Use this medicine for external use only. Follow the prescribed dosage and administration carefully. Be careful not to let it touch skin other than the area being treated.
entries.이 약에 과민증 환자, 임신 3기는 이 약을 사용하지 마십시오.눈, 눈: Patients with hypersensitivity to this medicine and women in the third trimester of pregnancy must not use this medicine. Do not use this medicine on the eyes or around the eyes. Before using this medicine, pregnant women (in the first and second trimesters, when it is absolutely necessary), those who have experienced allergic symptoms caused by medicines or cosmetics, and patients with severe moist skin or maceration should consult a doctor or pharmacist. Be careful not to let it get into the eyes, and if it does, rinse immediately with water or lukewarm water. Use this medicine for external use only. Follow the prescribed dosage and administration carefully. If you swallow this medicine by mistake, consult a doctor or pharmacist.
entries.이 약에 과민증 환자, 임신 3기는 이 약을 사용하지 마십시오.이 약을: Patients with hypersensitivity to this medicine and women in the third trimester of pregnancy should not use this medicine. Before using this medicine, pregnant women (in the first and second trimesters, when use is unavoidable), people who have experienced allergic symptoms to medicines or cosmetics, and patients with severe moist skin or skin breakdown should consult a doctor or pharmacist. Use it only on the areas with acne or pimples, and do not use it on large surrounding areas, on the eyes or the area around the eyes, on deep wounds, or on severe burns. Be careful not to let it get into the eyes; if it does get into the eyes, rinse immediately with clean water. This medicine is for external use only. Follow the prescribed dosage and administration exactly. Be careful not to let it touch skin other than the area of application.
entries.이 약에 과민증 환자, 중증(심한 증상)의 간 및 신기능 장애, 중증(심: Patients with hypersensitivity to this medicine, patients with severe liver and kidney dysfunction, severe coronary heart disease, urination disorder, high blood pressure, or coronary artery disease, pregnant women or women who may be pregnant, nursing mothers, infants aged 2 years or younger, and patients with hypersensitivity to methylparaben must not take this medicine. Before taking this medicine, patients with asthma, glaucoma, arrhythmia, diabetes, or hyperthyroidism, and children under 12 years of age, should consult a doctor or pharmacist. Follow the prescribed dosage and administration carefully. When giving it to children, administer it under the guidance and supervision of a guardian. Be careful when driving or operating machinery after taking it.
entries.이 약에 과민증 환자, 피부감염증(결핵, 매독, 칸디다증, 백선, 대상포: Patients who are hypersensitive to this medicine, patients with skin infections (tuberculosis, syphilis, candidiasis, ringworm, shingles, chickenpox, vaccinia, scabies, pubic lice), patients with a damaged immune system (bone marrow transplantation or AIDS), patients with eczematous otitis externa with a perforated eardrum, ulcers (excluding Behcet's disease), burns and frostbite of deep second degree or worse, perioral dermatitis, acne vulgaris, or rosacea, breastfeeding women, children under 18 years of age, and patients who have or have had a myocardial infarction must not use this medicine. Before using this medicine, women who are pregnant or may be pregnant and elderly people should consult a doctor or pharmacist. Follow the prescribed dosage and administration carefully. Use it only on cold sores on the lips or around the mouth, and do not use it in the eyes, nose, mouth, or on the genitals. Do not use it on people who have no signs or symptoms. Do not use it for the purpose of preventing transmission to others or preventing recurrent herpes simplex infection. Do not use this medicine as a base for diluting it or mixing it with other medicines.
entries.이 약에 과민증 환자, 피부감염증(피부결핵, 매독, 칸디다증, 백선, 대: Patients with hypersensitivity to this medicine, patients with skin infections (skin tuberculosis, syphilis, candidiasis, ringworm, shingles, herpes simplex, chickenpox, vaccinia, scabies, pubic lice), eczematous otitis externa with perforation of the eardrum, ulcers (excluding Behcet's disease), deep burns and frostbite of grade 2 or higher, perioral dermatitis, acne vulgaris, or rosacea must not use this medicine. Do not use it on or around the eyes, on mucous membranes, on eczema accompanied by skin infection, on wounds, on sensitive skin, or on suppurating affected areas (diseased sites). Before using this medicine, children, pregnant women or women who may be pregnant and breastfeeding women, elderly people, people with an allergic constitution, and patients with moist skin, skin maceration, severe inflammation or an extensive diseased area should consult a doctor or pharmacist. Follow the prescribed dosage and administration carefully. When giving this medicine to children, administer it under the guidance and supervision of a guardian. Use this medicine for external use only; do not use it internally. Be careful not to let this medicine get into the eyes, and if it does, rinse immediately with water. Do not use occlusive dressings without a doctor's supervision. Do not use it for purposes other than treatment, such as after applying makeup or shaving. Shake this medicine well before use. Be careful, because using this medicine on dyed hair may cause the color to fade.
Patients hypersensitive to this drug should not take this drug.
entries.이 약에 과민증 환자는 이 약을 복용하지 마십시오.이 약을 복용하기 전에: Patients with hypersensitivity to this medicine should not take it. Before taking this medicine, patients who must severely restrict sodium, such as those with congestive heart failure or renal impairment, patients with hypercalcemia, nephrocalcinosis, or recurrent calcium-containing kidney stones, and children under 12 years of age should consult a doctor or pharmacist. If symptoms do not improve after 7 days of treatment, stop taking it immediately and consult a doctor or pharmacist.

Patients with hypersensitivity to this medicine must not take it. Before taking this medicine, patients with congestive heart failure, kidney disorder, hypercalcemia, nephrocalcinosis, or recurrent calcium-containing kidney stones, and children under 12 years of age, should consult a doctor or pharmacist.

Patients who are hypersensitive to this medicine must not take this medicine. Before taking this medicine, pregnant women, breastfeeding women, and patients with uremia should consult a doctor or pharmacist. Dilute it before oral administration.

Patients with hypersensitivity to this medicine must not take this medicine. Before taking this medicine, pregnant women and breastfeeding women should consult a doctor or pharmacist. Follow the prescribed dosage and administration carefully. This medicine may turn the urine yellow and affect clinical test results. Use this medicine orally only; do not use it for injection. If there is no improvement in symptoms after taking it for a certain period, stop using it immediately and consult a doctor or pharmacist.

Patients with hypersensitivity to this medicine should not take it. Before taking this medicine, pregnant women and breastfeeding women should consult a doctor or pharmacist. Follow the prescribed dosage and administration exactly. If symptoms do not improve or become worse after taking it for a certain period, consult a doctor or pharmacist. Use it for oral administration only; do not use it for injection. It may turn the urine yellow and affect clinical laboratory test values.

Patients with hypersensitivity to this medicine must not take it. Before taking this medicine, patients who are deficient in folic acid should consult a doctor or pharmacist. Follow the prescribed dosage and administration carefully. When giving it to children, administer it under the guidance and supervision of a guardian. Do not use this medicine as a treatment for anemia.
entries.이 약에 과민증 환자는 이 약을 사용하지 마십시오.눈 또는 눈주위, 점막: Patients who are hypersensitive to this medicine must not use this medicine. Do not use it on the eyes or around the eyes, on mucous membranes, on eczema, on dermatitis caused by lacquer, on wounded areas, or on sensitive skin. Before using this medicine, consult a doctor or pharmacist if you have experienced allergic symptoms from medicines or cosmetics (rash and redness (congested and reddened), itching, dermatitis caused by lacquer, etc.), if you have an allergic constitution, moist skin (dampness), severe erosion, circulatory disorders, or diabetes, if the user is a child aged 12 years or younger, or if you are pregnant, may be pregnant, or are breastfeeding. If there is no improvement in symptoms after 5 to 6 days of use, stop using it immediately and consult a doctor or pharmacist. Follow the prescribed dosage and administration carefully. When using it in children, use it under the guidance and supervision of a guardian. Use this medicine for external use only; do not use it internally or inhale it. Be careful not to let it get into the eyes, and if it does get into the eyes, rinse them with water. Wash any solution off your hands thoroughly. Do not cover or wrap the treated area, and do not expose it to external heat or hot water. If water touches the area where this medicine has been used, you may feel strong irritation. Patients with particularly delicate skin must not use this medicine repeatedly on the same area. Do not use it for a long period.
entries.이 약에 과민증 환자는 이 약을 사용하지 마십시오.이 약을 사용하기 전에: Patients with hypersensitivity to this medicine must not use this medicine. Before using this medicine, patients with bronchial asthma or other respiratory diseases related to airway hypersensitivity, patients with allergic diseases, pregnant women, breastfeeding women, and children under 18 years of age should consult a doctor or pharmacist. Do not take it orally. Do not use it on or around the eyes or ears, and if it is applied there by mistake, rinse thoroughly with water. Do not use it on tissue with poor blood circulation, on wounds and ulcers (ulceration), or on externally non-bleeding wound areas (corrosive exfoliative changes). If you apply too much of this medicine, wash it off with water. It may cause discoloration of oral surfaces such as the tooth surfaces, dental prostheses, and the underside of the tongue.

Patients with hypersensitivity to this medicine must not use this medicine. Before using this medicine, consult a doctor or pharmacist if the user has bronchial asthma or accompanying respiratory insufficiency, is a pregnant woman or a woman who may be pregnant or a breast-feeding woman, is a child, or is elderly. Do not use it as an injection or as eye drops. After nebulization therapy the face mask may stick to the face, but it comes off easily when washed with water.

Patients with hypersensitivity to this medicine should not use it. Before using this medicine, patients with bronchial asthma or accompanying respiratory insufficiency, pregnant women, breastfeeding women, elderly people, and children should consult a doctor or pharmacist. Do not use it as an injection or as eye drops.

Patients with hypersensitivity to this medicine must not use this medicine. Before using this medicine, consult a doctor or pharmacist if the user has severe eye pain, has glaucoma, or has experienced allergic symptoms caused by eye drops, such as redness of the eye, itching, swelling or rash. Use this medicine only as eye drops, that is, only as a medicine to be put into the eye. If the symptoms worsen or last for 3 days or more, stop using this medicine immediately and consult a doctor or pharmacist. Wash the hands thoroughly before use. When using a single-use product for the first time, discard the first 1 to 2 drops without instilling them, in order to remove any fragments of the container that may be produced when it is opened. After opening, use a single-use product only once and discard the remaining solution and the container, and use a preservative-free multi-use product for up to 4 weeks only. Do not let the tip of the container touch the eyelid or the eyelashes. If it does, the solution may become contaminated or cloudy from eye mucus, mold and the like. Also, do not use the medicine if it has become cloudy. To prevent contamination, do not share it with others. This medicine can be used even while contact lenses are being worn. Follow the prescribed directions and amounts.

Patients with hypersensitivity to this medicine must not use it. Before using this medicine, people with severe eye pain and those who have experienced allergic symptoms from eye drops such as redness of the eye, itching, swelling, or rash should consult a doctor or pharmacist. Use this medicine only for instillation, that is, as a medicine put into the eye. If you swallow this medicine by mistake, get help from a doctor or another professional immediately. If symptoms worsen or last for 72 hours or longer, stop using this medicine immediately and consult a doctor or pharmacist. Do not reuse it after 1 use. After instilling it in the eye, discard the remaining solution and the container. To avoid contamination of this medicine and damage to the eye, do not let the tip of the container touch the eye or any outside surface. Do not use it if the color of the medicine has changed or if it has become cloudy. Do not use it as a wetting solution for soft contact lenses or while wearing soft contact lenses. Remove contact lenses before using this medicine. Put them back on 15 minutes after instilling it in the eye. Follow the prescribed dosage and administration carefully.

Patients with hypersensitivity to this medicine must not use this medicine. Before using this medicine, consult a doctor or pharmacist if the user has severe eye pain, has ever had allergic symptoms caused by eye drops (for example redness of the eye, itching, swelling, rash, redness with congestion, etc.), or has glaucoma. Follow the prescribed directions and amounts. Use this medicine only as eye drops. Wash the hands thoroughly before use. To prevent contamination, do not share it with others. If the symptoms worsen or last for 3 days or more, stop using it immediately and consult a doctor or pharmacist.

Patients who are hypersensitive to this medicine must not use this medicine. Before using this medicine, patients with severe eye pain, patients who have experienced allergic reactions to eye drops (redness of the eye, itching, swelling, rash, congestion and reddening, etc.), and patients with glaucoma should consult a doctor or pharmacist. If the symptoms become worse or last for 3 days or more, stop using it immediately and consult a doctor or pharmacist. Follow the prescribed dosage and administration carefully. Use this medicine for instillation into the eye only. Wash your hands thoroughly before use. In the case of single-use products, discard the first 1 to 2 drops without instilling them when first using it. This is to remove any container fragments produced when opening it. Since it is a single-use preparation, use it only 1 time after opening, and discard the remaining solution and the container after instillation. If the tip of the container touches the eyelid or eyelashes, the solution may become contaminated or cloudy from eye mucus or mold, so be careful, and do not use it if it has become cloudy. To prevent contamination, avoid sharing it with others as far as possible. This medicine can be used even while wearing contact lenses.

Patients with hypersensitivity to this medicine must not use this medicine. Before using this medicine, patients with severe eye pain and people who have previously had allergic symptoms caused by eye drops (for example, redness of the eyes, itching, swelling, rash, reddening, etc.) should consult a doctor or pharmacist. Use this medicine for instillation into the eye only. Follow the prescribed dosage and administration carefully. Do not use it if it has become cloudy. Do not use it as a wetting solution for soft contact lenses or while wearing soft contact lenses. To prevent contamination, avoid sharing it with others as far as possible. If there is no improvement in symptoms after 3 days of use, stop using it immediately and consult a doctor or pharmacist.

Patients with hypersensitivity to this medicine should not use it. Before using this medicine, patients with significant corneal damage should consult a doctor or pharmacist. If there is no improvement in symptoms after about 2 weeks of use, stop using it immediately and consult a doctor or pharmacist. Follow the prescribed dosage and administration exactly. When using it in a child, use it under the guidance and supervision of a guardian. Use this medicine for instillation into the eye only. When using it for the first time, discard 1 to 2 drops without instilling them. Use this medicine only once after opening it. Be careful, because if the tip of the container touches the eyelid or eyelashes the solution may become contaminated or cloudy (turbid) from eye discharge or mold. Also, do not use it if it has become cloudy (turbid). To prevent contamination, avoid sharing it with others as far as possible.

Patients with hypersensitivity to this medicine must not use it. Before using this medicine, patients with significant corneal damage should consult a doctor or pharmacist. Use this medicine only for instillation, that is, as a medicine put into the eye. After opening, use it only 1 time, and discard the remaining solution and the container after instilling it in the eye. If symptoms do not improve after about 2 weeks of use, stop using this medicine immediately and consult a doctor or pharmacist. When using it for the first time, discard 1 to 2 drops without instilling them, in order to remove any fragments of the container that may be produced when it is opened. Do not let the tip of the container touch the eyelids or eyelashes. If it does, the solution may become contaminated or cloudy because of eye mucus, mold, and the like. Also, do not use medicine that has become cloudy. To prevent contamination, do not share it with others. Children should use it under the guidance and supervision of a guardian. Follow the prescribed dosage and administration carefully.

Patients who are hypersensitive to this medicine must not use this medicine. Before using this medicine, patients with significant corneal damage should consult a doctor or pharmacist. Use this medicine only for instillation, that is, as a medicine put into the eye. Use it only 1 time after opening, and discard the remaining solution and the container after putting it into the eye. If the symptoms do not improve after about 2 weeks of use, stop using it immediately and consult a doctor or pharmacist. When using it for the first time, discard the first 1 to 2 drops without instilling them in order to remove any container fragments that may be produced when opening it. Do not let the tip of the container touch the eyelid or eyelashes. If it does, the solution may become contaminated or cloudy from eye mucus or mold. Also, do not use the medicine if it has become cloudy. To prevent contamination, do not share it with others. Children should use it under the guidance and supervision of a guardian. Follow the prescribed dosage and administration carefully.

Patients with hypersensitivity to this medicine must not use this medicine. Before using this medicine, patients with significant corneal damage should consult a doctor or pharmacist. Follow the prescribed dosage and administration carefully. When giving this medicine to children, administer it under the guidance and supervision of a guardian. Use this medicine for instillation into the eye only. When using it for the first time, discard the first 1 to 2 drops without instilling them (to remove any container fragments produced when opening it). Be careful, because if the tip of the container touches the eyelid or eyelashes the solution may become contaminated or cloudy from eye mucus or mold, and do not use it if it has become cloudy. To prevent contamination, avoid sharing it with others as far as possible.

Patients with hypersensitivity to this medicine should not use it. Before using this medicine, pregnant women or women who may be pregnant and breastfeeding women, patients with bronchial asthma or accompanying respiratory insufficiency, elderly people, and children should consult a doctor or pharmacist. It is not used as an injection or as eye drops. After nebulization therapy the face mask may stick to the face, but it comes off easily when washed with water.

Patients with hypersensitivity to this medicine must not use it. Before using this medicine, pregnant women or women who may be pregnant, nursing mothers, and children should consult a doctor or pharmacist. Do not use an occlusive dressing or wrapping unless directed by a doctor. In the case of candidiasis, do not use acidic soap. Apply this medicine externally only. Do not use it on acute inflammation or on open wound areas. Be careful not to let it touch the eyes, nose, mouth, or other mucous membranes.

Patients with hypersensitivity to this medicine must not use this medicine. Before using this medicine, a pregnant woman or a woman who may be pregnant and a breast-feeding woman, and children, should consult a doctor or pharmacist. Apply this medicine externally only. Do not use this medicine for the eyes, apply it carefully so that it does not touch the eyes, and if it gets into the eyes by mistake, rinse them out completely with plenty of water. Do not use it on a scalp with a wound or inflammation or on an area of severe erosion.

Patients who are hypersensitive to this medicine must not use this medicine. Before using this medicine, patients whose affected area is extensive should consult a doctor or pharmacist. Use this medicine for external use only. Be careful not to let it get into the eyes, and if it does get into the eyes, rinse them immediately with clean water.
entries.이 약에 과민증 환자는 이 약을 사용하지 마십시오.체표면적의 10 % 까: Patients with hypersensitivity to this medicine must not use this medicine. Use it on no more than 10 % of the body surface area, and avoid contact with the eyes, middle ear, meninges, and brain. Since this is a single-use product, using it on more than one patient may cause cross-contamination or infection. Use it with caution in newborns, especially premature infants, because it may cause chemical burns to the skin.
entries.이 약에 과민증, 감염성 또는 삼출성 피부병 환자는 이 약을 사용하지 마: Patients with hypersensitivity to this medicine and patients with infectious or exudative skin disease should not use this medicine. Avoid contact with the eyes. If you have applied this medicine to treat cracked nipples while breastfeeding, wipe it off before breastfeeding.
entries.이 약에 과민증, 갑상선기능 이상 환자(특히 결절성 갑상선종, 지방병성: This medicine must not be used by patients with hypersensitivity to this medicine, by patients with thyroid dysfunction (especially nodular goiter, endemic goiter, Hashimoto's thyroiditis, etc.), by patients with renal failure, by newborns and infants under 6 months of age, by patients with dermatitis herpetiformis, or by patients before or after radioactive iodine treatment. Before using this medicine, patients in a serious condition (burn patients, etc.), patients who have had a thyroid disease, patients who have had renal failure, and pregnant or breast-feeding women should consult a doctor or pharmacist. If it has been used right before delivery, wash the newborn's eyes and bathe the baby as soon as possible after the delivery so that the medicine does not remain on the skin. Do not use it for the eyes or internally. If the undiluted solution gets into the eyes, rinse them out immediately with clean water. Do not mix it with other preparations for use. When this medicine is used on a patient with extensive burns, provide sufficient fluids. Because this medicine has a spermicidal action, do not use it if pregnancy is desired.

Patients with hypersensitivity to this medicine, patients with thyroid dysfunction (especially nodular goiter, endemic goiter, Hashimoto's thyroiditis, etc.), patients with renal failure, newborns and infants under 6 months of age, patients with dermatitis herpetiformis, and patients before or after radioactive iodine treatment must not use this medicine. Before using this medicine, seriously ill patients (such as burn patients), those with a history of thyroid disease, and those with a history of renal failure should consult a doctor or pharmacist. If it is used just before delivery, wash the newborn's eyes and bathe the baby as soon as possible after delivery, taking care that the medicine does not remain on the baby. Do not use this medicine in the eyes or take it by mouth. If the undiluted solution gets into the eyes, rinse it out. Do not mix it with other preparations. Soap weakens the germicidal action of this medicine, so wash it off thoroughly before use. For details, please refer to the approved labeling.
entries.이 약에 과민증, 갑상선기능 이상 환자, 6세 미만의 소아, 방사성요오드: Patients who are hypersensitive to this medicine, patients with thyroid dysfunction, children under 6 years of age, and patients who are undergoing radioactive iodine therapy or are before or after such therapy must not use this medicine. Before using this medicine, patients with severe sores in the mouth and women who are pregnant, may be pregnant, or are breastfeeding should consult a doctor or pharmacist. Follow the prescribed dosage and administration carefully. When giving it to a child, administer it under the guidance and supervision of a guardian. Use it for the mouth only.
entries.이 약에 과민증, 다른 해열진통제, 감기약 복용 시 천식 경험자, 만 2: Those with hypersensitivity to this medicine, those who have experienced asthma when taking other antipyretic analgesics or cold remedies, children under 2 years of age, and infants (babies and newborns) under 3 months of age must not take this medicine. Follow the prescribed dosage and administration carefully. When giving this medicine to children, use it under the guidance and supervision of a guardian. Drowsiness may occur after taking this medicine, so be careful when driving or operating machinery.
entries.이 약에 과민증, 다른 해열진통제, 감기약 복용 시 천식 경험자, 만 3: People with hypersensitivity to this medicine, people who have experienced asthma when taking other antipyretic analgesics or cold remedies, infants under 3 months of age and children under 2 years of age, and people who are taking an MAO inhibitor (antidepressants, antipsychotics, mood regulators, antiparkinsonian drugs, etc.) or who stopped taking one within the past 2 weeks should not take this medicine. Before taking this medicine, infants and children under 15 years of age who are infected with or suspected of having chickenpox or influenza, people with an allergic constitution, people who have experienced allergic symptoms from medicines (e.g., fever, rash, joint pain, asthma, itching, etc.), people with liver disease, kidney disease, heart disease, thyroid disease, diabetes, high blood pressure, gastroduodenal ulcer, glaucoma (e.g., eye pain, blurred vision, etc.), or difficulty urinating, elderly people, people who are physically weak or have a high fever, people whose gastrointestinal problems such as heartburn, stomach discomfort, or stomach pain persist or recur or who have ulcers or bleeding problems, pregnant women or women who may be pregnant and breastfeeding women, and patients with smoking, asthma, chronic bronchitis, or emphysema, a cough accompanied by excessive phlegm, a cough that lasts 1 week or more or recurs, a chronic cough, or a cough accompanied by fever, rash, or persistent headache should consult a doctor or pharmacist. Follow the prescribed dosage and administration exactly. When giving it to a child, administer it under the guidance and supervision of a guardian. Drowsiness may occur after taking it, so be careful when driving or operating machinery. If there is no improvement in symptoms after 5 to 6 doses, stop taking it immediately and consult a doctor or pharmacist.
entries.이 약에 과민증, 만 12개월 미만의 젖먹이, 심한 신부전 환자는 이 약: Patients with hypersensitivity to this medicine, infants under 12 months of age, and patients with severe renal failure must not take this medicine. Before taking this medicine, infants under 1 year of age, patients who are under a doctor's treatment, pregnant women and women who may be pregnant, nursing mothers, premature infants, young children, and patients with cardiac and circulatory dysfunction, kidney (renal) disorder, or hypoproteinemia should consult a doctor or pharmacist. Follow the prescribed dosage and administration carefully. When it is used for children, use it under the guidance and supervision of a guardian. It may turn the urine yellow and affect clinical laboratory test values.
People who are hypersensitive to this medicine and nursing infants under 3 months of age must not take this medicine. Before taking this medicine, consult a doctor or pharmacist if the user is a nursing infant under 1 year of age, if you are pregnant, may be pregnant, or are breastfeeding, or if the user is a premature infant or a young child. This medicine contains sodium benzoate, and benzoic acid can be a mild irritant to the skin, eyes, and mucous membranes. Take this medicine by mouth only; do not use it for injection. Follow the prescribed dosage and administration carefully. When giving it to a child, administer it under the guidance and supervision of a guardian. It may turn the urine yellow and thereby affect clinical test values. If there is no improvement in symptoms after taking it for about 1 month, stop taking it immediately and consult a doctor or pharmacist.
entries.이 약에 과민증, 만 6세 미만의 소아, 뇌경질막이 노출되는 수술이나 나: Those with hypersensitivity to this medicine, children under 6 years of age, people who have undergone surgery exposing the dura mater or transsphenoidal hypophysectomy, patients with closed-angle glaucoma, rhinitis sicca or atrophic rhinitis, and people who are taking MAO inhibitors (antidepressants, antipsychotics, mood regulators, antiparkinsonian agents, etc.) or are within 2 weeks of stopping them must not use this medicine. Before using this medicine, people with an allergic constitution, those who have experienced allergic symptoms caused by medicines (including nasal sprays for rhinitis) (for example, fever, rash and redness, swelling, irritation, joint pain, asthma, itching, etc.), people with high blood pressure, cardiovascular disease, hyperthyroidism, diabetes, pheochromocytoma, benign prostatic hyperplasia, insomnia or dizziness, pregnant women or women who may be pregnant, breastfeeding women, and patients with smoking, asthma, chronic bronchitis, emphysema, cough with excessive phlegm, cough lasting or recurring for 1 week or more, chronic cough, or cough accompanied by fever, rash or persistent headache should consult a doctor or pharmacist. Follow the prescribed dosage and administration carefully. When using it for children, use it under the guidance and supervision of a guardian. Use this medicine only as a nasal spray for rhinitis (nasal inflammation), and do not use it in the eyes or ears. Do not use it continuously for 1 week or more. If there is no improvement in symptoms after 3 days of use, stop using it immediately and consult a doctor or pharmacist.
entries.이 약에 과민증, 세균(결핵, 매독 등)ㆍ진균(칸디다증, 백선 등)ㆍ스피: Patients with hypersensitivity to this medicine, skin infections caused by bacteria (tuberculosis, syphilis, etc.), fungi (candidiasis, ringworm, etc.), spirochetes, yeasts, viruses (herpes zoster, herpes simplex, chickenpox, vaccinia, etc.), or animal parasites (scabies, pubic lice, etc.), eczematous otitis externa with perforation of the eardrum, ulcers (excluding Behcet's disease), deep second-degree or more severe burns and frostbite, perioral dermatitis, acne vulgaris, rosacea, and patients with hypersensitivity to aminoglycoside antibiotics such as streptomycin, kanamycin, gentamicin, and neomycin, or to bacitracin should not use this medicine. Before using this medicine, people who have experienced hypersensitivity or an allergic reaction to propylene glycol, pregnant women or women who may be pregnant and breastfeeding women, and infants and children should consult a doctor or pharmacist. Follow the prescribed dosage and administration exactly. When using it in a child, use it under the guidance and supervision of a guardian. Avoid long-term or large-volume use and occlusive dressings. Do not use it for the eyes. It is not used for purposes other than treatment, such as with makeup or after shaving. If there is no improvement in symptoms after 3 to 4 weeks of treatment, stop using it immediately and consult a doctor or pharmacist.
entries.이 약에 과민증, 심한 신기능장애 또는 간기능장애, 심근경색 경험자는 이: This medicine must not be taken by patients with hypersensitivity to this medicine, by patients with severe renal dysfunction or hepatic dysfunction, or by patients who have had myocardial infarction. Before taking this medicine, consult a doctor or pharmacist if the user has a problem with urinary retention (urine collecting in the bladder), is a pregnant woman or a woman who may be pregnant or a breast-feeding woman, is taking it continuously for 15 days or more, or has had hypersensitivity or an allergic reaction to caramel. Follow the prescribed directions and amounts.
entries.이 약에 과민증, 심한 신기능장애 또는 간기능장애, 심근경색 환자 및 경: Patients with hypersensitivity to this medicine, patients with severe kidney dysfunction or liver dysfunction, and patients with or a history of myocardial infarction must not take this medicine. Before taking this medicine, people with urinary retention problems, pregnant women or women who may be pregnant and nursing mothers, people who take it continuously for 15 days or longer, and patients with hypersensitivity to caramel should consult a doctor or pharmacist. Follow the prescribed dosage and administration carefully.
entries.이 약에 과민증, 염증성 장질환 환자(궤양성 대장염, 크론병 등), 독성: People who are hypersensitive to this medicine and patients with inflammatory bowel disease (ulcerative colitis, Crohn's disease, etc.), toxic megacolon, intestinal perforation, intestinal obstruction, intestinal stricture, or abdominal pain of unknown cause must not take this medicine. Do not take this medicine for a long period without a doctor's judgment. Before taking this medicine, consult a doctor or pharmacist if you are pregnant, may be pregnant, or are breastfeeding, if you have acute constipation not caused by a change in lifestyle habits (such as acute constipation accompanied by pain, fever, or abdominal distension), if you have irritable bowel syndrome, or if you have a hypersensitivity reaction to macrogol (polyethylene glycol). Do not give this medicine to children for more than 3 months.
entries.이 약에 과민증, 염증성 장질환(궤양성 대장염, 크론병 등), 독성거대결: This medicine must not be taken by patients with hypersensitivity to this medicine, by patients with inflammatory bowel disease (ulcerative colitis, Crohn's disease, etc.) or toxic megacolon, by patients with intestinal perforation or at risk of intestinal perforation, by patients who have or are suspected of having intestinal obstruction, by patients with intestinal stricture, or by patients with abdominal pain of unknown cause. Before taking this medicine, consult a doctor or pharmacist if the user is a pregnant woman or a woman who may be pregnant or a breast-feeding woman, has acute constipation that is not caused by a change in lifestyle habits or acute constipation accompanied by pain, fever or abdominal distension, has irritable bowel syndrome, or has a hypersensitivity reaction to macrogol (polyethylene glycol). In children, do not give this medicine for 3 months or more, and do not give this medicine for a long period without the judgment of a doctor.
entries.이 약에 과민증, 위·십이지장 궤양 환자, 2세 미만 영아, 갈락토오스: Those with hypersensitivity to this medicine, patients with gastric or duodenal ulcer, infants under 2 years of age, and patients with hereditary problems such as galactose intolerance, Lapp lactase deficiency or glucose-galactose malabsorption must not take this medicine. Before taking this medicine, pregnant women and breastfeeding women should consult a doctor or pharmacist.
entries.이 약에 과민증, 위장관 궤양, 위장관 출혈 또는 경험자, 기관지 천식: Patients with hypersensitivity to this medicine, gastrointestinal ulcer, or gastrointestinal bleeding or those who have experienced them, patients with bronchial asthma or those who have experienced it, patients with asthma attacks, emphysema, or difficulty breathing due to chronic bronchitis, patients with hypersensitivity such as asthma, urticaria, or allergic reactions to aspirin or other non-steroidal anti-inflammatory analgesics (including COX-2 inhibitors) or those who have experienced it, patients with severe blood abnormalities, severe hepatic impairment, severe renal impairment, severe cardiac insufficiency, or severe high blood pressure, patients with pain occurring before or after coronary artery bypass graft surgery (CABG), patients with glaucoma or lower urinary tract obstructive disease such as benign prostatic hyperplasia, children under 15 years of age, patients with convulsive disorders such as epilepsy, patients with pheochromocytoma, patients with insomnia without pain or with pain without insomnia, and pregnant women or women who may be pregnant and breastfeeding women should not take this medicine. Before taking this medicine, patients with blood abnormalities or those who have experienced them, patients with a bleeding tendency, patients with liver cirrhosis or hepatic impairment or those who have experienced it, patients with renal impairment or those who have experienced it, patients with cardiac insufficiency or heart disease, high blood pressure, or a history of hypersensitivity, patients with systemic lupus erythematosus (SLE) and mixed connective tissue disease (MCTD), patients with ulcerative colitis or Crohn's disease, elderly people aged 65 years and older and children, people who take low-dose aspirin to prevent myocardial infarction or stroke, and patients with chickenpox, myasthenia gravis, diabetes, or thyroid disease should consult a doctor or pharmacist. If there is no improvement in symptoms after about 5 days of use, stop taking it immediately and consult a doctor or pharmacist. Drowsiness may occur after taking it, so be careful when driving or operating machinery. When using it in a child, use it under the guidance and supervision of a guardian. Follow the prescribed dosage and administration exactly.
entries.이 약에 과민증, 위장관 궤양, 위장관 출혈환자 또는 경험자, 심한 혈액: Patients with hypersensitivity to this medicine, patients with or a history of gastrointestinal ulcer or gastrointestinal bleeding, patients with severe blood disorders, severe liver disorder, severe kidney disorder, severe cardiac insufficiency, severe high blood pressure, or bronchial asthma or a history of it, patients with or a history of hypersensitivity reactions such as asthma, urticaria, or allergic reactions to aspirin or other non-steroidal anti-inflammatory analgesics (including COX-2 inhibitors), patients in whom pain occurs before or after coronary artery (heart artery) bypass graft surgery (CABG), pregnant women in the last 3 months of pregnancy, patients receiving high-dose methotrexate as cancer chemotherapy, and patients with genetic problems such as galactose intolerance, Lapp lactase deficiency, or glucose-galactose malabsorption must not take this medicine. Before taking this medicine, patients with or a history of blood disorders, patients with a bleeding tendency, patients with cirrhosis or with or a history of liver disorder, patients with or a history of kidney disorder, patients with cardiac insufficiency, heart disease, high blood pressure, hypersensitivity, systemic lupus erythematosus (SLE), mixed connective tissue disease (MCTD), ulcerative colitis, or Crohn's disease, elderly people, children, pregnant women, nursing mothers, and those who have experienced hypersensitivity or allergy to Yellow No. 5 (Sunset Yellow FCF) should consult a doctor or pharmacist. Do not take more than the recommended dose. In case of an overdose, get prompt medical treatment even if there are no obvious symptoms or signs.
entries.이 약에 포함된 성분에 과민반응이 나타나는 경우 이 약의 사용을 즉각 중: If a hypersensitivity reaction to an ingredient contained in this medicine occurs, stop using this medicine immediately and consult a doctor or pharmacist.
entries.이 약에 포함된 성분에 대한 과민반응이 나타나는 경우 이 약의 사용을 즉: If a hypersensitivity reaction to the ingredients contained in this medicine occurs, stop using this medicine immediately and consult a doctor or pharmacist.
entries.이 약은 1차성, 2차성 카르니틴결핍증, 허혈성심질환에 의한 심근대사장애: This medicine is used for primary (type 1) and secondary (type 2) carnitine deficiency and for myocardial metabolic disorders caused by ischemic heart disease (angina, acute myocardial infarction).
entries.이 약은 2차 감염된 알레르기성 또는 염증성 피부질환 (습진, 접촉피부염: This medicine is used for secondarily infected allergic or inflammatory skin diseases (eczema, contact dermatitis, seborrheic dermatitis, atopic dermatitis, photodermatitis, lichen simplex chronicus, intertrigo, exfoliative dermatitis, itching, psoriasis) and for first-degree burns.
entries.이 약은 2차 감염된 알레르기성 또는 염증성 피부질환(습진, 접촉피부염,: This medicine is used for allergic or inflammatory skin diseases with 2nd (secondary) infection (eczema, contact dermatitis, seborrheic dermatitis, atopic dermatitis, photodermatitis, lichen simplex chronicus, intertrigo, exfoliative dermatitis, itching, psoriasis) and for 1st-degree burns.
entries.이 약은 가려움, 벌레물린데, 두드러기, 땀띠, 옻 등에 의한 접촉피부염: This medicine is used for itching, insect bites, hives, prickly heat, contact dermatitis caused by lacquer and the like, chilblains, eczema, dermatitis, and erosion.
This medicine is used as supportive treatment for detoxification in severe liver disease such as cirrhosis.
This medicine is used as adjunctive treatment for liver disease.
entries.이 약은 감기, 비염, 부비동염, 수술로 인한 비강 염증에 의한 코막힘,: This medicine is used to relieve nasal congestion and runny nose caused by a cold, rhinitis, sinusitis, or nasal inflammation resulting from surgery.
entries.이 약은 감기로 인한 발열 및 동통(통증), 두통, 신경통, 근육통, 월: This medicine is used for fever and pain (aches) caused by a cold, headache, neuralgia, muscle pain, menstrual pain, sprain pain (pain from a sprain), toothache, joint pain, and rheumatic pain (aches)
This medicine is used for fever and pain caused by colds, headache, neuralgia, muscle pain, menstrual pain, sprain pain, toothache, joint pain, and rheumatic pain.
entries.이 약은 감기로 인한 발열 및 통증, 두통, 신경통, 근육통, 월경통,: This medicine is used for fever and pain due to colds, headache, neuralgia, muscle pain, menstrual pain, and pain from sprains. This medicine is used for toothache, joint pain, and rheumatic pain.
entries.이 약은 감기의 여러 증상(인후(목구멍)통, 기침, 가래, 오한(춥고 떨: This medicine is used to relieve the various symptoms of a cold (sore throat, cough, phlegm, chills (feeling cold and shivering), fever, headache, joint pain, muscle pain).
entries.이 약은 감기의 여러 증상(인후(목구멍)통, 오한(춥고 떨리는 증상),: This medicine is used to relieve various symptoms of a cold (sore throat, chills, fever, headache, joint pain, muscle pain).
entries.이 약은 감기의 여러 증상(인후통, 기침, 가래, 오한(춥고 떨리는 증상: This medicine is used to relieve the various symptoms of a cold (sore throat, cough, phlegm, chills (feeling cold and shivering), fever, headache, joint pain, muscle pain).
entries.이 약은 감기의 여러 증상(인후통, 오한(춥고 떨리는 증상), 발열, 두: This medicine is used to relieve the various symptoms of a cold (sore throat, chills (feeling cold and shivering), fever, headache, joint pain, muscle pain).
entries.이 약은 감기의 여러 증상(인후통, 오한, 발열, 두통, 관절통, 근육통: This medicine is used to relieve the various symptoms of a cold (sore throat, chills, fever, headache, joint pain, muscle pain).

entries.이 약은 다음과 같은 순서대로 사용합니다.어플리케이터의 포장을 벗기고 스: Use this medicine in the following order. Remove the applicator from its packaging and hold it with the sponge facing downwards. Do not touch the sponge part of the applicator. Squeeze the applicator firmly only once so that the ampoule breaks and the solution comes out, and leave the broken ampoule inside the applicator. For the 26 mL product, squeeze the lever on the handle firmly, and for the other products squeeze both wings firmly. Do not squeeze or press the wings repeatedly in order to wet the sponge quickly. Press and release the sponge against the treatment area until the solution is visible on the skin, wetting the sponge and completely wetting the treatment area with the solution. For a dry surgical site (e.g. the abdomen or an arm), once the solution is visible on the skin, rub gently back and forth for 30 seconds to treat that area. For a moist surgical site (e.g. the groin fold), rub gently back and forth repeatedly for about 2 minutes. Let the area to which the solution has been applied dry completely in the air, and do not wipe the solution off. Discard the applicator after a single use, together with any remaining solution that was not used on the treatment area. It is not necessary to use the entire amount.

entries.이 약은 주사용염화나트륨용액, 흡입용염화나트륨용액, 주사용멸균증류수, 흡: This medicine may be diluted to a lower concentration with sodium chloride solution for injection, sodium chloride solution for inhalation, sterile distilled water for injection or sterile distilled water for inhalation. For nebulization therapy using a face mask, a mouthpiece or a tracheostomy, nebulize 1 to 10 mL every 2 to 6 hours. The recommended amount is 3 to 5 mL nebulized 3 to 4 times a day. Nebulization therapy using a nebulization tent or an inhaler (Croupette) is a method needed in special cases, and it is used individually according to the personal needs of the patient and the convenience of the method of administration. This method of administration requires a large volume of solution, and sometimes as much as about 300 mL may be required for a single treatment. The recommended amount should be an amount that can maintain a very dense mist-like state inside the tent or the inhaler during the treatment period. Intermittent or continuous administration over a long period is preferable. For direct instillation, give 1 to 2 mL every hour. For the regular treatment of a patient who has had a tracheostomy, give 1 to 2 mL through the tracheostomy every 1 to 4 hours. When a small plastic catheter is inserted into the trachea under local anesthesia through a direct incision to give it directly to a specific part of the bronchial tree, give 2 to 5 mL every 1 to 4 hours using a syringe connected to the catheter. When it is given using a percutaneous intrabronchial catheter, give 1 to 2 mL of this medicine every 1 to 4 hours with a syringe connected to the catheter. For diagnostic bronchography, give 1 to 2 mL 2 to 3 times by nebulization or by intrabronchial instillation before the bronchography is performed.
entries.이 약은 진행성 지장각피증(주부습진의 건조형), 손·발바닥 각피증, 어린: This medicine is used for progressive keratoderma of the palms (the dry form of housewife's eczema), keratoderma of the palms and soles, ichthyosis, senile xerosis, keratosis pilaris, and atopic skin.
entries.이 약은 찢긴 상처, 화상, 창상(상처), 욕창의 살균소독, 궤양, 농양: This medicine is used for the sterilization and disinfection of torn wounds, burns, wounds and bedsores, the sterilization and disinfection of ulcers and abscesses, the disinfection of infected skin surfaces, the sterilization and disinfection of surgical sites, and the disinfection of injection and catheter sites.
entries.이 약은 찢긴 상처, 화상, 창상의 살균소독, 궤양, 농양의 살균소독,: This medicine is used for disinfection of lacerations, burns and wounds, disinfection of ulcers and abscesses, disinfection of infected skin surfaces, disinfection of surgical sites, and disinfection of injection and catheter sites.

This medicine is used for the sterilization and disinfection of torn wounds, burns and wounds, the sterilization and disinfection of ulcers and abscesses, the disinfection of infected skin surfaces, the sterilization and disinfection of surgical sites, and the disinfection of injection and catheter sites.
This medicine is used for iron deficiency anemia.
entries.이 약은 체내에서 페닐알라닌으로 대사되는 아스파탐이 함유되어 페닐알라닌의: Because this medicine contains aspartame, which is metabolized to phenylalanine in the body, patients with phenylketonuria who need to restrict phenylalanine intake should not take it.
entries.이 약은 치열 및 치핵의 아픔이나 가려움, 부종이나 출혈의 일시적 완화에: This medicine is used for the temporary relief of pain or itching, swelling, and bleeding from anal fissures and hemorrhoids.
entries.이 약은 치열·치핵의 아픔·가려움·부종(부기)·출혈의 일시적인 완화에 사: This medicine is used for the temporary relief of pain, itching, swelling (puffiness), and bleeding from anal fissures and hemorrhoids.
entries.이 약은 치육점막이 상승된 히알루론산 농도를 필요로 하는 치은염, 잇몸출: This medicine is used to treat inflammatory conditions such as gingivitis and bleeding gums, in which the gum mucosa requires an increased concentration of hyaluronic acid, and traumatic conditions such as those after scaling, stripping, tooth extraction, or surgical procedures.
entries.이 약은 치은염(잇몸염), 구내염(입안염), 인두염 등의 구강인두의 염증: This medicine is used to relieve inflammation of the mouth and the pharynx such as gingivitis, stomatitis and pharyngitis, and inflammation after conservative dental treatment or tooth extraction.
entries.이 약은 치은염(잇몸염), 치은출혈, 보철(의치)에 의한 염증의 통증 완: This medicine is used to relieve the pain of inflammation caused by gingivitis, bleeding gums, and dental prostheses (dentures).
entries.이 약은 치은염, 구내염, 인두염, 후두염, 발치 전·후에 의한 통증 및: This medicine is used to relieve pain and inflammation caused by gingivitis, stomatitis, pharyngitis, laryngitis, and tooth extraction (before and after), and for disinfection.
entries.이 약은 치은염, 구내염, 혀염, 입술염, 사랑니주위염 및 치조 농루의: This medicine is used to relieve gingivitis, stomatitis, glossitis, cheilitis, pericoronitis around a wisdom tooth, and alveolar pyorrhea.
entries.이 약은 치주(치아주위조직) 치료 후 치은염(잇몸염), 경·중등도 치주(: This medicine is used as supportive treatment for gingivitis (inflammation of the gums) after periodontal (tissue around the teeth) treatment and for mild to moderate periodontitis (inflammation of the tissue around the teeth).
entries.이 약은 칸디다성 질염, 트리코모나스성 질염, 비특이성 및 혼합감염에 의: This medicine is used for the local treatment of candidal vaginitis, trichomonal vaginitis, vaginitis caused by non-specific and mixed infection and preparation before obstetric and gynecological surgery, and for germicidal vaginal washing, local washing and deodorizing.
This medicine is used for candidal vaginitis.
entries.이 약은 코감기(급성비염(코염)), 알레르기성 비염(코염) 또는 부비동염: This medicine is used to relieve nasal congestion, runny nose, sneezing, and a heavy feeling in the head caused by a head cold (acute rhinitis (nasal inflammation)), allergic rhinitis (nasal inflammation), or sinusitis.
entries.이 약은 코감기(급성비염), 알레르기성 비염 또는 부비동염에 의한 코막힘: This medicine is used to relieve stuffy nose, runny nose, sneezing, watery eyes, sore throat, and a heavy feeling in the head caused by a nasal cold (acute rhinitis), allergic rhinitis, or sinusitis.
This medicine is used to relieve nasal congestion, runny nose, sneezing, and a heavy feeling in the head caused by a head cold (acute rhinitis), allergic rhinitis, or sinusitis.
entries.이 약은 코감기, 알레르기 및 혈관운동성 코염에 의한 재채기, 콧물, 코: This medicine is used to relieve sneezing, runny nose, nasal congestion, and watery eyes due to a head cold, allergic rhinitis, and vasomotor rhinitis.
entries.이 약은 코감기, 알레르기성 비염 또는 부비동염에 의한 코막힘, 콧물,: This medicine is used to relieve nasal congestion, runny nose, sneezing, and a heavy feeling in the head caused by a head cold, allergic rhinitis, or sinusitis.
entries.이 약은 코감기, 알레르기성 비염, 또는 부비동염에 의한 코막힘, 콧물,: This medicine is used to relieve the symptoms of nasal congestion, runny nose, sneezing, and a heavy feeling in the head caused by a head cold, allergic rhinitis, or sinusitis.
entries.이 약은 코점막 분비물 또는 화농(곪음)성으로 인한 코막힘에 비강(코안): This medicine is used for washing the nasal cavity (the inside of the nose) for a stuffy nose caused by nasal mucosal discharge or suppuration (festering), and to relieve dryness of the nasal mucosa.
entries.이 약은 코점막 분비물 또는 화농성 (곪음)으로 인한 코막힘에 코 안 세: This medicine is used for rinsing the inside of the nose in cases of nasal congestion caused by nasal mucous secretions or suppuration (festering), and to relieve dryness of the nasal mucosa.
entries.이 약은 콧물, 코막힘, 재채기, 인후(목구멍)통, 기침, 가래, 오한(: This medicine is used to relieve the various symptoms of a cold, such as runny nose, nasal congestion, sneezing, sore throat, cough, phlegm, chills (feeling cold and shivering), fever, headache, joint pain, and muscle pain.
entries.이 약은 콧물, 코막힘, 재채기, 인후통, 기침, 가래, 오한, 발열,: This medicine is used to relieve various symptoms of a cold, such as runny nose, nasal congestion, sneezing, sore throat, cough, phlegm, chills, fever, headache, joint pain and muscle pain.
entries.이 약은 콧물, 코막힘, 재채기, 인후통, 기침, 가래, 춥고 떨리는 증: This medicine is used to relieve various symptoms of a cold, such as runny nose, nasal congestion, sneezing, sore throat, cough, phlegm, chills with shivering, fever, headache, joint pain and muscle pain.
entries.이 약은 통증으로 인한 일시적인 불면을 동반하는 급성 야간 통증에 사용합: This medicine is used for acute night-time pain accompanied by temporary insomnia caused by the pain.
entries.이 약은 피부, 창상면, 점막의 세정, 습포 및 함소, 분무 흡입제로서: This medicine is used for cleansing the skin, wound surfaces, and mucous membranes, for wet compresses and gargling, as a spray inhalant for cleansing the mucous membranes and promoting the expulsion of sputum, and for cleaning medical instruments.
entries.이 약은 피부, 창상면, 점막의 세정, 습포, 함소, 분무흡입제로서 점막: This medicine is used for cleansing the skin, wound surfaces, and mucous membranes, for wet compresses, for gargling, and, as a spray inhalation, for cleansing mucous membranes and promoting the expulsion of sputum, as well as for cleansing medical instruments.
entries.이 약은 피부사상균, 효모, 곰팡이, 기타 진균에 의한 피부진균증(백선,: This medicine is used as an adjunct to creams or solutions for skin fungal infections caused by dermatophytes, yeasts, molds and other fungi (ringworm, cutaneous candidiasis, tinea versicolor), for skin diseases with superinfection by these fungi, and for erythrasma caused by Corynebacterium, and it is used in particular to prevent reinfection in infections such as athlete's foot.
entries.이 약은 피부사상균에 의한 피부진균(곰팡이)감염증(무좀, 완선(사타구니백: This medicine is used for fungal skin infections caused by dermatophytes (athlete's foot, jock itch (tinea cruris), ringworm).
This medicine is used for contraception.
entries.이 약은 필요 시 2~3시간마다 각 코 안에 뿌립니다.횟수는 연령에 따라: Spray this medicine into each nostril every 2 to 3 hours as needed. The number of sprays varies according to age. Insert the nozzle into the nostril and point its tip slightly backwards. Press the pump firmly to activate the spray, spray the specified amount into both nostrils, then tilt your head to the right for 10 seconds and then to the left for 10 seconds. After that, hold your nose with your hand to close the nostrils and bend your head forward for 10 seconds. Infants may be given 1 spray, those aged 1 month to 12 months 1 to 2 sprays, those aged 1 to 2 years 1 to 3 sprays, those aged 2 to 5 years 1 to 4 sprays, those aged 5 to 8 years 1 to 5 sprays, those aged 8 to 12 years 1 to 6 sprays, and adults 1 to 8 sprays.
entries.이 약은 항문생식기 부분(질, 외음부, 음경귀두 포함)에서 진단, 수술,: This medicine is used for disinfection of the anogenital area (including the vagina, external genitalia, and glans penis) before diagnosis, surgery, or catheter insertion, and for short-term disinfection of small wounds.
entries.이 약은 해열 및 감기로 인한 통증, 두통, 근육통, 월경통, 치통, 허: This medicine is used to reduce fever and to relieve pain caused by a cold, headache, muscle pain, menstrual pain, toothache, low back pain, and joint pain.
entries.이 약은 효모균에 의한 다음의 피부질환(비듬, 지루피부염, 어루러기)에: This medicine is used for the following skin diseases caused by yeast fungi (dandruff, seborrheic dermatitis, tinea versicolor).
entries.이 약은 효모균에 의한 비듬, 지루피부염의 치료와 재발방지 및 어루러기의: This medicine is used for the treatment and the prevention of recurrence of dandruff and seborrheic dermatitis caused by yeast, and for the treatment of tinea versicolor.
Avoid using this medicine at the same time as other disinfectants.
entries.이 약을 다른 점안제와 동시에 사용할 경우에는 다른 점안제를 먼저 사용하: When you use this medicine at the same time as another eye drop, use the other eye drop first and use this medicine about 10 minutes later.
entries.이 약을 다른 점안제와 동시에 사용할 경우에는 다른 점안제를 사용하고 약: When using this medicine at the same time as other eye drops, instill this medicine about 10 minutes after using the other eye drops.
When using this medicine at the same time as other eye drops, instill this medicine about 10 minutes after using the other eye drops.
entries.이 약을 다른 점안제와 동시에 사용할 경우에는 이 약을 사용하기 전에 최: When this medicine is used at the same time as other eye drops, leave an interval of at least 15 minutes before using this medicine.
entries.이 약을 복용하기 전에 3개월 미만의 영아는 의사 또는 약사와 상의하십시: Before taking this medicine, infants under 3 months of age should consult a doctor or pharmacist. Follow the prescribed dosage and administration carefully. When giving it to a child, administer it under the guidance and supervision of a guardian. If there is no improvement in symptoms after taking it for about 1 month, stop taking it immediately and consult a doctor or pharmacist.
entries.이 약을 복용하기 전에 다른 약물을 복용하고 있는 경우 의사 또는 약사와: Before taking this medicine, if you are taking other medicines, consult a doctor or pharmacist.
entries.이 약을 복용하기 전에 발진, 발적(충혈되어 붉어짐), 가려움 등을 일으: Before taking this medicine, people who have had rash, redness, or itching should consult a doctor or pharmacist. Follow the prescribed dosage and administration carefully.
entries.이 약을 복용하기 전에 비스테로이드성 소염(항염)진통제, 무좀치료제 및: Before taking this medicine, patients taking non-steroidal anti-inflammatory analgesics, athlete's foot treatments and antifungal agents (such as itraconazole and posaconazole oral suspension), or tyrosine kinase inhibitors (dasatinib, erlotinib, gefitinib, pazopanib, etc.) should consult a doctor or pharmacist.
