entries.이 약을 복용하기 전에 약에 과민증 환자, 두드러기, 접촉성 피부염, 기: Before taking this medicine, patients with hypersensitivity to a medicine, people with a constitution prone to urticaria, contact dermatitis, bronchial asthma, allergic rhinitis, migraine, food allergy and the like, people who have experienced allergic symptoms (for example, fever, rash, joint pain, asthma, itching, etc.), infants and children (aged 14 years or under) who are infected with or suspected of having chickenpox or influenza, people with liver disease, kidney disease, thyroid disease, diabetes, high blood pressure or high fever, people who are physically weak, elderly people, women who are pregnant or may be pregnant, and breast-feeding women should consult a doctor or pharmacist. Follow the prescribed usage and dosage carefully. When it is given to a child, it should be given under the guidance and supervision of a guardian.
entries.이 약을 복용하기 전에 약에 과민증 환자, 알레르기 체질, 간장애, 신장: Before taking this medicine, patients with hypersensitivity to medicines, those with an allergic constitution, patients with liver disorder, kidney disorder, thyroid disease, diabetes, high fever, high blood pressure, heart disorder, or edema, frail people, elderly people, pregnant women or women who may be pregnant and nursing mothers, and children under 2 years of age should consult a doctor or pharmacist. Follow the prescribed dosage and administration carefully. When giving it to children, administer it under the guidance and supervision of a guardian.
entries.이 약을 복용하기 전에 임부 또는 임신하고 있다고 생각되는 사람은 의사: Before taking this medicine, women who are pregnant or think they may be pregnant should consult a doctor or pharmacist. Follow the prescribed dosage and administration carefully. If there is no improvement in symptoms after taking it for about 2 weeks, stop taking it immediately and consult a doctor or pharmacist.
entries.이 약을 복용하기 전에 항응고제를 투여하고 있는 환자는 의사 또는 약사와: Before taking this medicine, patients who are taking anticoagulants should consult a doctor or pharmacist.
entries.이 약을 복용하는 동안 다른 진토제, 감기약, 해열진통제, 항히스타민제,: While taking this medicine, do not take other antiemetics, cold remedies, antipyretic analgesics, antihistamines, sedatives, antitussives and expectorants, or alcoholic drinks.
entries.이 약을 복용하는 동안 아세트아미노펜을 포함하는 다른 제품, MAO억제제: While taking this medicine, do not take it together with other products containing acetaminophen, MAO inhibitors (antidepressants, antipsychotics, mood regulators, antiparkinsonian drugs, etc.), antitussives and expectorants, other cold medicines, antipyretic analgesics, sedatives, or oral medicines containing antihistamines (oral preparations for rhinitis, motion sickness medicines, anti-allergy medicines). Consult a doctor or pharmacist when taking it together with barbiturates, tricyclic antidepressants, potassium-containing preparations, licorice-containing preparations, preparations containing glycyrrhizic acid or its salts, loop diuretics (furosemide, ethacrynic acid), or thiazide diuretics (trichlormethiazide). Do not drink alcohol while taking this medicine.
entries.이 약을 복용하는 동안 인산염, 칼슘염, 경구용 테트라사이클린계 제제,: While taking this medicine, do not take phosphates, calcium salts, oral tetracycline preparations, antacids, or levodopa. Avoid teas containing tannin, such as green tea and black tea, while taking it and before and after taking it.

entries.이 약을 복용하는 동안 인산염, 칼슘염, 경구용 테트라사이클린계 항생제,: While taking this medicine, do not take phosphates, calcium salts, oral tetracycline antibiotics, or antacids. entries.이 약을 복용하는 동안 테오필린, 리토나비어, 과량의 알코올과 함께 복용: Do not take this medicine together with theophylline, ritonavir, or excessive alcohol while taking it.
entries.이 약을 복용하는 동안 테오필린, 리토나비어와 함께 복용하지 마십시오.이: While taking this medicine, do not take it together with theophylline or ritonavir. While taking this medicine, do not take it together with a large amount of alcohol.
entries.이 약을 복용하는 동안 테트라사이클린, 디곡신, 플루오로퀴놀론, 철염(I: While taking this medicine, allow an interval of 2 hours between it and tetracycline, digoxin, fluoroquinolones, iron salts, ketoconazole, neuroleptics, thyroxine, penicillamine, beta blockers (atenolol, metoprolol, propranolol), glucocorticoids, chloroquine, estramustine, and diphosphonates.

entries.이 약을 복용하는 동안에는 다른 진토제, 감기약, 해열진통제, 항히스타민: While taking this medicine, do not take other antiemetics, cold remedies, antipyretic analgesics, antihistamines, sedatives, antitussives and expectorants, or gastrointestinal analgesics and antispasmodics. entries.이 약을 사용하기 전에 눈의 통증이 심한 사람, 녹내장 환자, 안약에 의: Before using this medicine, people with severe eye pain, patients with glaucoma, and those who have experienced allergic symptoms caused by eye drops such as redness of the eyes, itching, swelling or rash should consult a doctor or pharmacist. If blurred vision does not improve with the use of this medicine, or if there is no improvement in symptoms after using it for several days, stop using this medicine immediately and consult a doctor or pharmacist. Use this medicine only for instillation into the eye. Do not let the tip of the container touch the eyelid or eyelashes. If it does, the solution may become contaminated or cloudy from eye mucus or mold. Also, do not use the medicine if it has become cloudy. To prevent contamination, do not share it with others. Do not use it as a wetting solution for soft contact lenses or while wearing soft contact lenses. Follow the prescribed dosage and administration carefully. entries.필요시 증상이 있는 눈에 1~2방울씩 점안하고, 점안 후 남은 액과 용기: As needed, instill 1 to 2 drops into the affected eye, and after instillation discard the remaining solution and the container. When using it at the same time as other eye drops, instill them at least 15 minutes apart to avoid a dilution effect.
entries.필요시 증상이 있는 눈에 1~2방울씩 점안합니다.점안 후 남은 액과 용기: As needed, instill 1 to 2 drops into the affected eye. After instillation, discard the remaining solution and the container.
entries.필요시 증상이 있는 눈에 1~2방울을 점안하고 점안 후 남은 액과 용기는: When necessary, instill 1 to 2 drops into the eye that has symptoms, and discard the remaining solution and the container after instillation. When it is used at the same time as another eye drop, leave an interval of at least 15 minutes between instillations in order to avoid a dilution effect.
entries.하루에 한번 환부(질환 부위)에 바릅니다.해당 부위를 따뜻한 물에 담근: Apply it to the affected area (the diseased site) once a day. Soak the area in warm water, dry it completely, and gently rub the surface of the wart, corn, or callus with a pumice stone or a nail file to remove the hard skin. Using the applicator provided, carefully apply a few drops of this medicine to the affected area, letting each drop dry before applying the next. Be careful to apply it with the applicator only to the affected area, and for warts on the sole of the foot, cover with an adhesive plaster and leave it for 24 hours. Remove the plaster first and then repeat the procedure daily.
entries.항생물질, 테트라사이클린, 에리트로마이신, 브롬헥신 등과 함께 복용(사용: Consult a doctor or pharmacist when it is used together with an antibiotic, tetracycline, erythromycin, bromhexine or the like.
entries.항생물질과 병용할 필요가 있는 경우에는 각각 흡입하거나 항생물질을 주사: When it is necessary to use this medicine together with an antibiotic, inhale them separately, or give the antibiotic by injection or orally.
entries.항암요법으로 고용량 메토트렉세이트를 투여중인 환자, 다른 비스테로이드성: Patients receiving high-dose methotrexate as cancer chemotherapy should not take this medicine, and do not take this medicine together with other non-steroidal anti-inflammatory analgesics. Before taking this medicine, people taking low-dose aspirin or ACE inhibitors and patients taking lithium, furosemide and thiazide diuretics, low-dose methotrexate, coumarin anticoagulants (such as warfarin), or selective serotonin reuptake inhibitors should consult a doctor or pharmacist.
Do not take it together with an antipsychotic or a sleeping pill.
entries.항정신병약과 수면제와 함께 복용하지 마십시오.최면효과를 증가시킬 수 있습: Do not take it together with an antipsychotic and a sleeping pill. They may increase the hypnotic effect.
entries.항히스타민제, 항세로토닌, 근이완제(파파베린)와 함께 사용 시 의사 또는: Consult a doctor or pharmacist when using it together with antihistamines, antiserotonin agents, or muscle relaxants (papaverine).
entries.현기증, 위장장애, 상복부 통증, 메스꺼움, 설사, 홍반, 발진, 반구진: If dizziness, gastrointestinal disorders, upper abdominal pain, nausea, diarrhea, erythema, rash, maculopapular rash, hives, eczema, itching, swelling, or fluid retention in patients with heart failure occurs, stop taking this medicine immediately and consult a doctor or pharmacist.
entries.혈압강하제, 알코올, 중추신경억제제(수면제, 진정제, 안정제), MAO: Do not take it together with antihypertensives, alcohol, central nervous system depressants (hypnotics, sedatives, tranquilizers), MAO inhibitors, sympathomimetics, tricyclic antidepressants, guanethidine, bretylium, bethanidine, debrisoquine, methyldopa, sympathomimetic drugs (decongestants, appetite suppressants, amphetamine-type neurostimulants), and adrenergic blockers (inhibitors).
entries.혈액학적 이상 반응 등이 나타나는 경우 복용을 즉각 중지하고 의사 또는: If hematological adverse reactions occur, stop taking this medicine immediately and consult a doctor or pharmacist.
entries.호흡곤란, 온몸이 붉어짐, 혈관부기, 두드러기 등의 쇽 증상 혹은 천식발: If shock symptoms such as difficulty breathing, reddening of the whole body, angioedema, or urticaria, or an asthma attack, thrombocytopenia, granulocytopenia, hemolytic anemia, methemoglobinemia, decreased platelet function (prolonged bleeding time), or hypersensitivity symptoms such as cyanosis, facial swelling, sweating, or low blood pressure, or nausea, vomiting, loss of appetite, gastrointestinal bleeding, peptic ulcer, perforation, rash, Stevens-Johnson syndrome (mucocutaneous ocular syndrome), toxic epidermal necrolysis (Lyell's syndrome), elevated AST, elevated ALT, or fixed drug eruption occurs, stop taking this medicine immediately and consult a doctor or pharmacist.
entries.환부를 깨끗이 씻어 내고 1일 2회씩, 아침, 저녁으로 환부에 충분한 양: Wash the affected area clean and apply a sufficient amount to the affected area 2 times in 1 day, in the morning and in the evening.
After washing the affected area, apply this medicine 1 to several times a day and then rub it in thoroughly.
entries.환부의 가장자리까지 충분히 적용할 수 있는 적당량으로 하여 1일 5회씩,: Use an amount sufficient to cover the affected area up to its edges, 5 times a day for 5 days. Start treatment as soon as possible as soon as the first symptoms and signs appear.
entries.환부의 크기와 삼출물의 정도에 따라 적절한 양을 1일 2~3회 감염된 피: Apply an appropriate amount to the infected skin 2 to 3 times a day, depending on the size of the affected area and the amount of exudate. This medicine may be used alternately with a cream or a solution. In the case of athlete's foot, it is advisable to spray it on shoes and socks to dry up moisture and prevent reinfection. The treatment period varies according to the severity and location of the disease. In general, it is used for 3 to 4 weeks for fungal skin infections, 1 to 3 weeks for tinea versicolor, 2 to 4 weeks for erythrasma, and 1 to 2 weeks for candidal perineal inflammation. Use it regularly for a sufficient period to obtain the full therapeutic effect. If mycological cure has not been achieved, treatment is generally continued for about 2 more weeks after all symptoms have disappeared.
entries.흔하게 건조감, 피부 벗겨짐, 때때로 일시적인 작열감, 저림, 드물게 홍: If commonly a feeling of dryness or peeling of the skin, occasionally a temporary burning sensation or numbness, rarely erythema, pigmentation, inflammation, bacterial (impetigo contagiosa, folliculitis, etc.) or fungal (candidiasis, tinea, etc.) skin infections, general skin symptoms (folliculitis, boils, skin irritation, stinging pain, fever, a burning sensation, rash, redness, flushing, itching, dry skin, pustular dermatitis, allergic contact dermatitis, heat rash, miliaria, worsening of wounds, bedsores, pustulosis), or, when it is used on the eyelid skin, increased intraocular pressure or glaucoma, or blurred vision of unknown frequency occurs, stop using this medicine immediately and consult a doctor or pharmacist.

If dryness or peeling of the skin commonly occurs, a temporary burning sensation or numbness sometimes occurs, or rarely erythema, pigmentation, application-site reactions including the signs and symptoms of inflammation, contact dermatitis, or impetigo contagiosa, folliculitis, candidiasis, ringworm, folliculitis, boils, skin irritation, stinging pain, fever, a burning sensation, rash, redness, flushing, itching, dry skin, pustular dermatitis, allergic contact dermatitis, prickly heat, sudamina, worsening of wounds, pressure sores, pustulosis, or, when used on the skin of the eyelids, a rise in intraocular pressure or glaucoma (blurred vision, impaired eyesight) occurs, stop using it immediately and consult a doctor or pharmacist. Systemic absorption may cause reversible Cushing's syndrome, high blood sugar, glucose in the urine, and visual impairment.
entries.흥분(특히 어린이), 현저한 졸음, 불안, 어지러움 또는 불면증, 인후(: If excitement (especially in children), marked drowsiness, anxiety, dizziness or insomnia occur, if a sore throat continues for 2 days or more or is accompanied by headache, fever, rash, nausea or vomiting, if severe skin adverse reactions such as acute generalized exanthematous pustulosis (AGEP), fever, erythema and numerous small pustules occur, or if ischemic colitis (sudden abdominal pain, rectal bleeding, etc.) occurs, stop taking this medicine immediately and consult a doctor or pharmacist. If symptoms of posterior reversible encephalopathy syndrome or reversible cerebral vasoconstriction syndrome (sudden severe headache, thunderclap headache, nausea, vomiting, confusion, seizures, visual disturbances, etc.) occur, stop taking this medicine immediately and consult a doctor or pharmacist.
